quotes.quote: The stoics divided philosophy into three branches: logic, physics, and ethics. Logic covered not only the rules of correct argumentation, but also grammar, linguistics, rhetorical theory, epistemology, and all the tools that might be needed to discover the truth of any matter. Physics was concerned with the nature of the world and the laws that govern it, and so included ontology and theology as well as what we would recognize as physics, astronomy, and cosmology. Ethics was concerned with how to achieve happiness, or how to live a fulfilled and flourishing life as a human being. A stoic sage was supposed to be fully expert in all three aspects.

quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Developing the extremely rare attitude of not minding how life is happening is a billion times better than prolonging your life, even if by a trillion years.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: There is a switch in the air tonight. It’s not suffocating, like breakups all those years ago, but clean and clear. He does not want me anymore so I tilt my head, take a breath and say, “Okay. I understand.” It’s calm now. My heart didn’t break, it kept on beating like a stoic marching forward without looking back, and I will be a writer now. I love so many people, still. I think I will write about them forever.
quotes.author: Charlotte Eriksson

quotes.quote: The mind, unconquered by violent passions, is a citadel, for a man has no fortress more impregnable in which to find refuge and remain safe forever.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: There is no correlation between the degree to which you are confident that you are right and the chances of you not being wrong.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Some people would be ashamed of driving the cars, or living in the houses, some people are showing off.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Our caring about what others think about us is one of the pillars of the economy.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: What does it mean to be getting an education? It means learning to apply natural preconceptions to particular cases as nature prescribes, and distinguishing what is in our power from what is not.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: We often mistake assuming or hoping for knowing.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: No, it is events that give rise to fear -- when another has the power over them or can prevent them, that person becomes able to inspire fear. How is the fortress destroyed? Not by iron or fire, but by judgments... here is where we must begin, and it is from this front that we must seize the fortress and throw out tyrants.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: Take it to mind, not to heart.
quotes.author: Nate Hamon

quotes.quote: You have two essential tasks in life: to be a good person and to pursue the occupation that you love. Everything else is a waste of energy and a squandering of your potential.
quotes.author: Ryan Holiday

quotes.quote: It usually takes maturity in a child, and immaturity in an adult, not to be on speaking terms with someone.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: No man is good by chance. Virtue is something which must be learned.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Don't just say you have read books. Show that through them you have learned to think better, to be a more discriminating and reflective person. Books are the training weights of the mind. They are very helpful, but it would be a bad mistake to suppose that one has made progress simply by having internalized their contents.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: A fool’s plans are entertainment for the wise.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: It is humbling to realize that what you hate (the most) about someone is actually what they love (the most) about themselves.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Some people get killed by water. Some die from dehydration.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: A true believer in God prays only to thank, never to ask; and welcomes, with open arms, every single thing that is happening.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Some people deny the existence of God in order to give themselves credit for their successes. Some accept His existence in order to deny responsibility for their failures.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Change is not always a bad thing: it sometimes takes the form of progress. And is not always a good thing: it sometimes takes the form of regress.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: For I am not everlasting, but a human being, a part of the whole as an hour is a part of the day. Like an hour I must come, and like an hour pass away.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: Engineers can prove that a bumblebee, with its heavy body and little bitty wings, can't fly. But nobody tells the bumblebees ... and they fly just fine.
quotes.author: Bill Bowerman

quotes.quote: The universe is change, and life mere opinion.
quotes.author: Democrates

quotes.quote: Nothing can affect a person’s mind if he chooses not to be affected by it.
quotes.author: Cave Man

quotes.quote: We have, not problems, but negative attitudes towards some situations (towards which some people have or would have positive attitudes).
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Nobody is stopping you from using things such as your ability to read or hear as your definition of ‘success’ or ‘wealth’.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: The fact that we are all going to die prevents the vast majority of people from being driven insane by the fact that they are going to die.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: An emotion is a mild mental illness.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Usually, that which could have been better could have been worse.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Giving in to sleep is a great opportunity to practice letting go of life.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: What some people regard as an expression of freedom is actually that of slavery.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: At the crisis of my fever, I besought Hollingsworth to let nobody else enter the room, but continually to make me sensible of his own presence… then he should be the witness how courageously I would encounter the worst. It still impresses me almost a matter of regret, that I did not die then, when I had tolerably made up my mind to do it
quotes.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

quotes.quote: Unless you learn your lesson, it will keep hurting. Not only it will never stop, it will also keep increasing the amount, so you won’t get used to it.
quotes.author: Cave Man

quotes.quote: Education almost always leaves stupidity intact.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: All too often, a wise or free person is ridiculed, because of ignorance, by fools or slaves.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Escaping death is a temporary victory.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Perhaps I did not always love him so well as I do now. But in such cases as these, a good memory is unpardonable.
quotes.author: Jane Austen

quotes.quote: Some things do not make sense, not in themselves, but to some people.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: The fear of being poor or broke is a blessing, if you are a successful entrepreneur; but is a curse, if you want to be an entrepreneur.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: People often give us a piece of their mind with the intention to take away our peace of mind.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Remember that you must behave in life as at a dinner party. Is anything brought around to you? Put out your hand and take your share with moderation. Does it pass by you? Don’t stop it. Is it not yet come? Don’t stretch your desire towards it, but wait till it reaches you. Do this with regard to children, to a wife, to public posts, to riches, and you will eventually be a worthy partner of the feasts of the gods. And if you don’t even take the things which are set before you, but are able even to reject them, then you will not only be a partner at the feasts of the gods, but also of their empire.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: The wise remind themselves that ‘This too shall pass’ even when things are good; the foolish, only when things are bad.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Happiness is an inevitable result of embracing, and unhappiness that of rejecting, what is.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: To some of us, these are the good old days in the making.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Hatred and love are equally enslaving.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Equanimity is often mistaken for depression.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: And if you want to know why all this running away cannot help you, the answer is simply this: you are running away in your own company.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: It takes, not cowardice, but courage to kill yourself.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Some people are a degree of impatience away from wishing a year were only a few weeks long.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Sometimes we are lucky to lose something or someone.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: For our happiness or unhappiness, we have only what we think about something or someone to thank or blame.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Life is 99 percent attitude. Yet for the majority of people, it is the remaining one percent that dominates 99 percent of their life.
quotes.author: Bill Madden

quotes.quote: why should I demand from fortune that she should give me this and that rather than demand from myself that I should not ask for them? why should I ask for them, after all? am I to pile them up in total forgetfulness of the frailty of human existence?
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: We cannot have, but can lose, everything.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: We sometimes learn, not from something, but from not having learned from it.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: The second best thing to not chasing success is chasing success that was defined by you, not for you.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: A man is as much a fool for shedding tears because he isn't going to be alive a thousand years from now.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: A man’s wealth must be determined by the relation of his desires and expenditures to his income. If he feels rich on ten dollars, and has everything else he desires, he really is rich.
quotes.author: John Davison Rockefeller

quotes.quote: We make life even more painful by having expectations and preferences.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: When someone wrongs you, ask yourself: What made him do it? Once you understand his concept of good and evil, you'll feel sorry for him and cease to either be amazed or angry. If his concept is similar to yours, then you will be bound to forgive him since you would have acted as he did in similar circumstances. But if you do not share his ideas of good and evil, then you should find it even easier to overlook the wrongs of someone who is confused and in a moral muddle".
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: How was your day?’ ought to be ‘How did you look at your day?
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Stoicism is Buddhism without the dogma.
quotes.author: Bill Madden

quotes.quote: The most common act of violence is the relentless mental violence we perpetrate upon ourselves with nothing other than our thoughts.
quotes.author: Bill Madden

quotes.quote: Our mind can be in heaven while our body is in hell. And vice versa.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: That you are about to bury or have just buried your loved one does not make you and your loved ones immortal for a while.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Love, unless it is for life as a whole, is contaminated by things such as our preferences and memories.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Patience is the antidote to the restless poison of the Ego. Without it we all become ego-maniacal bulls in china shops, destroying our future happiness as we blindly rush in where angels fear to tread. In these out-of-control moments, we bulldoze through the best possible outcomes for our lives, only to return to the scene of the crime later to cry over spilt milk.
quotes.author: Anthon St. Maarten

quotes.quote: To be everywhere is to be nowhere.
quotes.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quotes.quote: Confronting the worst-case scenario saps it of much of its anxiety-inducing power. Happiness reached via positive thinking can be fleeting and brittle, negative visualization generates a vastly more dependable calm.
quotes.author: Oliver Burkeman

quotes.quote: Philosophy calls for simple living, not for doing penance, and the simple way of life need not be a crude one.
quotes.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quotes.quote: What fortune has made yours is not your own.
quotes.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quotes.quote: And here lies the essential between Stoicism and the modern-day 'cult of optimism.' For the Stoics, the ideal state of mind was tranquility, not the excitable cheer that positive thinkers usually seem to mean when they use the word, 'happiness.' And tranquility was to be achieved not by strenuously chasing after enjoyable experiences, but by cultivating a kind of calm indifference towards one's circumstances.
quotes.author: Oliver Burkeman

quotes.quote: It is a ridiculous thing for a man not to fly from his own badness, which is indeed possible, but to fly from other men's badness, which is impossible.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: I must fling myself down and writhe; I must strive with every piece of force I possess; I bruise and batter myself against the floor, the walls; I strain and sob and exhaust myself, and begin again, and exhaust myself again; but do I feel pain? Never. How can I feel pain? There is no place for it.
quotes.author: Harry Houdini

quotes.quote: There was no sign of Plato, and I was told later that he had gone to live in his, where he was cheerfully submitting to his own. None of the Stoics were present. Rumour had it that they were still clambering up the steep hill of Virtue. As for the Sceptics, it appeared that they were extremely anxious to get there, but still could not quite make up their minds whether or not the island really existed.
quotes.author: Lucian of Samosata

quotes.quote: Sometimes in life we must fight not only without fear, but also without hope.
quotes.author: Alessandro Pertini

quotes.quote: There is, I assure you, a medical art for the soul. It is philosophy, whose aid need not be sought, as in bodily diseases, from outside ourselves. We must endeavor with all our resources and all our strength to become capable of doctoring ourselves.
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.quote: It is a great man that can treat his earthenware as if it was silver, and a man who treats his silver as if it was earthenware is no less great.
quotes.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quotes.quote: The boon that could be given can be withdrawn.
quotes.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quotes.quote: She (the First Lady, entering the room with her gravely wounded husband) would admit fear but not despair.
quotes.author: Candice Millard

quotes.quote: He is the kind of person I should expect to rescue one from a mad dog at any risk but then insist on a stoical indifference to the fright afterward." Jefferson Davis's future wife describing him at first meeting.
quotes.author: Shelby Foote

quotes.quote: Indeed this gentleman's stoicism was of that not uncommon kind, which enables a man to bear with exemplary fortitude the afflictions of his friends, but renders him, by way of counterpoise, rather selfish and sensitive in respect of any that happen to befall himself.
quotes.author: Charles Dickens

quotes.quote: He liked the English and their peculiarities. He liked their stoicism under pressure; on the wall in his factory he kept a copy of a war poster emblazoned with the Crown of King George and underneath the words “Keep Calm and Carry On.
quotes.author: Natasha Solomons

quotes.quote: The wife of a junior officer cooped up in a horrible canvas partition in steerage for five months wrote: "I had enjoyed much peace there in the absence of every comfort, even of such as are now enjoyed in jail. I used to say that there were four privations in my situation - fire, water, earth and air. No fire to warm oneself on the coldest day, no water to drink but what was tainted, no earth to set the foot on, and scarcely any air to breathe. Yet, with all these miserable circumstances, we spent many a happy hour by candlelight in that wretched cabin whilst I sewed and he read the Bible to me.
quotes.author: Stephen Taylor

quotes.quote: In his numerous historical and Scriptural works rejects all supernatural religion, and represents Christianity as a natural product of the mingling of the Stoic and Alexandrian philosophies...
quotes.author: Joseph McCabe

quotes.quote: Killing a person does not lead to nearly as much pain as creating a human being.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: We need not reply or even listen to people who are talking about—not to—us.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: All that exists is the seed of what will emerge from it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: An action is at least a billion times less difficult to choose than a reaction.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: You cannot be blessed with the ability to be happy without being cursed with the ability to be unhappy.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Some things are made way more appealing than they are by our lack of them.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: We ought to be thankful not only for what we have but also for what we do not have.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: The happiest people are not those who have the most, but those who are the most grateful for what they have.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Even most of those whose wealth was not inherited or won often lose sleep over losing their wealth.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: We have never tried to do most of the things we are dead sure we cannot do.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Feeling sorry for our bodies ought to be the closest we get to feeling sorry for ourselves.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: A blind man’s thoughts almost never have anything to do with the things he is facing.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Where you arrive does not matter as much as what sort of person you are when you arrive there.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: We ought not, therefore, to give over our hearts for good to any one part of the world. We should live with the conviction: 'I wasn‟t born for one particular corner: the whole world‟s my home country.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Men are of little worth. Their brief lives last a single day. They cannot hold elusive pleasure fast; It melts away. All laurels wither; all illusions fade; Hopes have been phantoms, shade on air-built shade, since time began.
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.quote: Some of the things we fear exist nowhere but where fear happens.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: The present isn’t more capable of causing mental pain than the past or the future.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: It is impossible to trip and fall while walking slowly.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Even the busiest bee does not move from one flower to another as often as an untamed mind moves from one thought to another.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Most people are like all stomachs: they cannot remain satisfied for a long time.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: What cause can there be for complaint, after all, in anything that was always bound to come to an end fading gradually away? What is troubling about that? Moving to one's end through nature's own gentle process of dissolution - is there a better way of leaving life than that? Not because there is anything wrong with a sudden, violent departure, but because this gradual withdrawal is an easy route.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Life is yet to produce someone who is loved by or important to everyone.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: They who always expect the worst are almost always pleasantly surprised.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: It would be foolish to be stoical all the time, you'd wear yourself out for nothing
quotes.author: John-Paul Sartre

quotes.quote: As things are, there is about wisdom a nobility and magnificence in the fact that she didn't just fall to a person's lot, that each man owes her to his own efforts, that one doesn't go to anyone other than oneself to find her.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: It is not the man who has too little that is poor, but the one who hankers after more.
quotes.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quotes.quote: Nothing, to my way of thinking, is a better proof of a well ordered mind than a man’s ability to stop just where he is and pass some time in his own company.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: I have always swung back and forth between alienation and relatedness. As a child, I would run away from the beatings, from the obscene words, and always knew that if I could run far enough, then any leaf, any insect, any bird, any breeze could bring me to my true home. I knew I did not belong among people. Whatever they hated about me was a human thing; the nonhuman world has always loved me. I can't remember when it was otherwise. But I have been emotionally crippled by this. There is nothing romantic about being young and angry, or even about turning that anger into art. I go through the motions of living in society, but never feel a part of it. When my family threw me away, every human on earth did likewise.
quotes.author: Wendy Rose

quotes.quote: From the philosopher Catulus, never to be dismissive of a friend's accusation, even if it seems unreasonable, but to make every effort to restore the relationship to its normal condition.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Remember two things: i. that everything has always been the same, and keeps recurring, and it makes no difference whether you see the same things recur in a hundred years or two hundred, or in an infinite period; ii. that the longest-lived and those who will die soonest lose the same thing. The present is all that they can give up, since that is all you have, and what you do not have you cannot lose.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Stop wandering about! You aren't likely to read your own notebooks, or ancient histories, or the anthologies you've collected to enjoy in your old age. Get busy with life's purpose, toss aside empty hopes, get active in your own rescue-if you care for yourself at all-and do it while you can.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: If what you have seems insufficient to you, then though you possess the world, you will yet be miserable.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: You need to avoid certain things in your train of thought: everything random, everything irrelevant. And certainly everything self-important or malicious. You need to get used to winnowing your thoughts, so that if someone says, "What are your thinking about?" you can respond at once (and truthfully) that you are thinking this or thinking that.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Today I escaped anxiety. Or no, I discarded it, because it was within me, in my own perceptions — not outside.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Some people avoid thinking deeply in public, only because they are afraid of coming across as suicidal.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Remember that all we have is “on loan” from Fortune, which can reclaim it without our permission—indeed, without even advance notice. Thus, we should love all our dear ones, but always with the thought that we have no promise that we may keep them forever—nay, no promise even that we may keep them for long.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: It is more necessary for the soul to be cured than the body; for it is better to die than to live badly.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: In your actions, don't procrastinate. In your conversations, don't confuse. In your thoughts, don't wander. In your soul, don't be passive or aggressive. In your life, don't be all about business.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: For death remembered should be like a mirror, Who tells us life’s but breath, to trust it error. ― William Shakespeare, Pericles. Act I, Scene i
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.quote: My boyfriends have all been as stoical as queen's guards. They'd been patient, committed, and dispassionate, and I'd had to really debase myself to extract any emotion, either grin or grimace, from them.
quotes.author: Koren Zailckas

quotes.quote: Thoroughly convinced of the impossibility of his own suit, a high resolve constrained him not to injure that of another. This is a lover's most stoical virtue, as the lack of it is a lover's most venial sin.
quotes.author: Thomas Hardy

quotes.quote: Here is your great soul—the man who has given himself over to Fate; on the other hand, that man is a weakling and a degenerate who struggles and maligns the order of the universe and would rather reform the gods than reform himself.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Philosophy does not promise to secure anything external for man, otherwise it would be admitting something that lies beyond its proper subject-matter. For as the material of the carpenter is wood, and that of statuary bronze, so the subject-matter of the art of living is each person's own life.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: There was a lot of pretense floating around; not just with aunties and all that but with emotions and how people saw you. They had a point. There's a lot to learn from that generation -- the stoic approach. I think it's disgusting how they've been forgotten about in this way. It's the American hippies' fault, they saw an in there, a way of making money out of bad moods. That's all it is most of the time. You can't expect to feel cock-a-hoop every minute of every day. My mam and dad's generation understood this. They were just thankful the bombs had stopped threatening their lives. They just wanted to get on with living.
quotes.author: Mark E. Smith

quotes.quote: A resistance that dispenses with consolations is always stronger than one which relies on them.
quotes.author: Perry Anderson

quotes.quote: Common man's patience will bring him more happiness than common man's power.
quotes.author: Amit Kalantri

quotes.quote: he saw and recognised the visible and he sought his place in this world. He did not seek reality; his goal was not on any other side. The world was beautiful when looked at in this way - without any seeking, so simple, so childlike. The moon and stars were beautiful, the brook, the shore, the forest and rock, the goat and the golden beetle, the flower and butterfly were beautiful. It was beautiful and pleasant to go through the world like that, so childlike, so awakened, so concerned with the immediate, without any distrust.
quotes.author: Hermann Hesse

quotes.quote: For in this Case, we are not to give Credit to the Many, who say, that none ought to be educated but the Free; but rather to the Philosophers, who say, that the Well-educated alone are free.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: It is impossible to lose everything and still be alive.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: The sun appears to pour itself down, and indeed its light pours in all direction, but the stream does not run out. This pouring is linear extension: that is why its beams are called rays, because they radiate in extended lines. You can see what a ray is if you observe the sun's light entering a dark room through a narrow opening. It extends in a straight line and impacts, so to speak, on any solid body in its path which blocks passage through the air on the other side: it settles there and does not slip off or fall.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: When force of circumstance upsets your equanimity, lose no time in recovering your self-control, and do not remain out of tune longer than you can help. Habitual recurrence to the harmony will increase your mastery of it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: The greatest obstacle to living is expectancy, which hangs upon tomorrow and loses today. You are arranging what is in Fortune's control and abandoning what lies in yours.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: When you run up against someone else’s shamelessness, ask yourself this: Is a world without shamelessness possible? No. Then don’t ask the impossible. There have to be shameless people in the world. This is one of them. The same for someone vicious or untrustworthy, or with any other defect. Remembering that the whole world class has to exist will make you more tolerant of its members.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: If you apply yourself to study you will avoid all boredom with life, you will not long for night because you are sick of daylight, you will be neither a burden to yourself nor useless to others, you will attract many to become your friends and the finest people will flock about you.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Just as the earth that bears the man who tills and digs it, to bear those who speak ill of them, is a quality of the highest respect.
quotes.author: Thiruvalluvar

quotes.quote: Why be concerned about others, come to that, when you've outdone your own self? Set yourself a limit which you couldn't even exceed if you wanted to, and say good-bye at last to those deceptive prizes more precious to those who hope for them than to those who have won them. If there were anything substantial in them they would sooner or later bring a sense of fullness; as it is they simply aggravate the thirst of those who swallow them.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Love sometimes injures. Friendship always benefits, After friendship is formed you must trust, but before that you must judge.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: It does good also to take walks out of doors, that our spirits may be raised and refreshed by the open air and fresh breeze: sometimes we gain strength by driving in a carriage, by travel, by change of air, or by social meals and a more generous allowance of wine.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Oh, dear me!" he lamented. "The raft has floated off and I suppose it's gone down that awful hole by now." "Well, never mind. We're not on it," said Snufkin gaily. "What's a kettle here or there when you're out looking for a comet!
quotes.author: Tove Jansson

quotes.quote: Someone has to be stoic, for the sake of, in spite of, and in the face of all those who are, not. Someone, has to be serious. Someone has to choose to forgo choice, so that there is an option left for others to consider. Everyone can't be, someone.
quotes.author: Justin K. McFarlane Beau

quotes.quote: So the life of a philosopher extends widely: he is not confined by the same boundary as are others. He alone is free from the laws that limit the human race, and all ages serve him as though he were a god.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: I fail to remember ever having made an effort — no trace of struggle is detectable in my life, I am the opposite of a heroic nature. To “want” something, to “strive” for something, to have an “end,” a “desire” in mind — I know none of this from my experience. Even at this moment I look out upon my future — a broad future! — as upon a smooth sea: no desire ripples upon it. Not in the least do I want anything to be different from what it is; I myself do not want to be any different. But thus I have always lived.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: A properly educated leader, especially when harassed and under pressure, will know from his study of history and the classics that circumstances very much like those he is encountering have occurred from time to time on this earth since the beginning of history. He will avoid the self-indulgent error of seeing himself in a predicament so unprecedented, so unique, as to justify his making an exception to law, custom or morality in favor of himself. The making of such exceptions has been the theme of public life throughout much of our lifetimes. For twenty years, we've been surrounded by gamesmen unable to cope with the wisdom of the ages. They make exceptions to law and custom in favor of themselves because they choose to view ordinary dilemmas as unprecedented crises.
quotes.author: James B. Stockdale

quotes.quote: To want to know more than is sufficient is a form of intemperance. Apart from which this kind of obsession with the liberal arts turns people into pedantic, irritating, tactless, self-satisfied bores, not learning what they need simply because they spend their time learning things they will never need. The scholar Didymus wrote four thousand works: I should feel sorry him if he had merely read so many useless works.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Love sometimes injures. Friendship always benefits
quotes.author: Seneca the Younger

quotes.quote: I smile to catch the piranhas from swimming out of my mouth.
quotes.author: Evan Mariah Pettit

quotes.quote: But Moominmamma was quite unperturbed. "Well, well!" she said, "it seems to me that our guests are having a very good time." "I hope so," replied Moominpappa. "Pass me a banana, please dear.
quotes.author: Tove Jansson

quotes.quote: These...xistential qualms you suffer, they just mean you're truly human. I aked how I might remedy them. "You don´t remedy them. You live thru them.
quotes.author: David Mitchell

quotes.quote: During the Great Depression, the philosophy of grin-and-bear-it became a national coping mechanism.
quotes.author: Maureen Corrigan

quotes.quote: Fourteen years without a mother had me believe I could be stoic when I finally met her.
quotes.author: Maria V. Snyder

quotes.quote: The Greeks not only face facts. They have no desire to escape from them.
quotes.author: Edith Hamilton

quotes.quote: In Tsurani culture, forgiveness was simply a less shameful form of weakness than capitulation.
quotes.author: Raymond E. Feist

quotes.quote: Emilio was certainly within his rights not to reveal the sordid details of his childhood even to his friends. Or perhaps especially to his friends, whose good opinion of him, he might feel, would not survive the revelations.
quotes.author: Mary Doria Russell

quotes.quote: I've come to the point where I never feel the need to stop and evaluate whether or not I am happy. I'm just 'being', and without question, by default, it works.
quotes.author: Criss Jami

quotes.quote: To the wise, peace of mind is the result of being fine with how things are; to the foolish, the result of things being fine.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: It takes a great degree of tolerance, and that of humility, to strongly disagree with someone, and not express your disagreement.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: It takes the whole of life to learn how to live... it takes the whole of life to learn how to die.
quotes.author: Lucius Seneca

quotes.quote: He never exhibited rudeness, lost control of himself, or turned violent. No one ever saw him sweat. Everything was to be approached logically and with due consideration, in a calm and orderly fashion but decisively, and with no loose ends.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: The world is maintained by change- in the elements and in the things they compose. That should be enough for you; treat it as an axiom.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: There is a limit to the time assigned to you, and if you don't use it to free yourself it will be gone and will never return.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: What is divine deserves our respect because it is good; what is human deserves our affection because it is like us. And our pity too, sometimes, for its inability to tell good from bad- as terrible a blindness as the kind that can't tell white from black.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Don't waste the rest of your time here worrying about other people- unless it affects the common good. It will keep you from doing anything useful.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Each of us lives only now, this brief instant. The rest has been lived already, or is impossible to see.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: It was for the best. So Nature had no choice but to do it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Does anything genuinely beautiful need supplementing? No more than justice does- or truth, or kindness, or humility. Are any of those improved by being praised? Or damaged by contempt? Is an emerald suddenly flawed if no one admires it?
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: So there are two reasons to embrace what happens. One is that it's happening to you. It was prescribed for you, and it pertains to you. The thread was spun long ago, by the oldest cause of all.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: But true good fortune is what you make for yourself. Good fortune: good character, good intentions, and good actions.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: When faced with people's bad behavior, turn around and ask when you have acted like that. When you saw money as a good, or pleasure, or social position. Your anger will subside as soon as you recognize that they acted under compulsion (what else could they do?)
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: That kindness is invincible, provided it's sincere- not ironic or an act. What can even the most vicious person do if you keep treating him with kindness and gently set him straight
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: When you start to lose your temper, remember: There's nothing manly about rage. It's courtesy and kindness that define a human being- and a man. That's who possesses strength and nerves and guts, not the angry whiners.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: We almost never teach or learn when arguing.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: He who has more money or possessions than you is not necessarily happier than you, happy more often than you, or happy like you.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Most people would rather believe something that is not true about something than accept the fact that they do not understand a thing about that thing.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Most people want more than they have without having made the most of what they have.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: That we can change the shadow of an object without changing the object (by changing the position of the source of light) reminds us that we can change how we feel about a situation or person by changing only how we look at it or them.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: It is a humbling practice to make a mental note whenever your assumption turns out to be wrong.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: We live life passively whenever we are not practicing mindfulness.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Ideally, a Stoic will be oblivious to the services he does for others, as oblivious as a grapevine is when it yields a cluster of grapes to a vintner. He will not pause to boast about the service he has performed but will move on to perform his next service, the way the grape vine moves on to bear more grapes.
quotes.author: William B. Irvine

quotes.quote: A truth whispered is not less truthful. And an untruth shouted is not less untruthful.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Some people are lucky to no longer be, and some are unlucky to still be, alive.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Some of our problems came to us; some, we went to them.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Destroying your mirrors leaves your facial blemishes intact.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: For some reason, there is this façade that life should be full of happiness and without its suffering. Which, actually makes us suffer even more. Because when we get sad or something bad happens, we do not only feel bad about the thing itself but we also feel bad because our life is not the way it is supposed to be. Not realizing suffering and sadness is just a part of life and they are inevitable.
quotes.author: Cave Man

quotes.quote: You can be invincible, if you enter into no contest in which it is not in your power to conquer.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: The problem with pleasure is that it needs to be intermittent in order to retain its pleasantness.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: It is foolish to give up on yourself. And doubly so to do that before everyone has given up on you.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Fools refuse to truly believe that a thing can be both delicious or pleasurable … and harmful.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: 99.99% of fools deny their foolishness. The rest underestimate it.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: When conversing, some people regularly stop talking, not to listen, but to rest their tongues.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: You are indeed a man of sorrows and have suffered much...pray be seated now, here on this chair, and let us leave our sorrows, bitter though they are, locked up in our own hearts, for weeping is cold comfort and does little good.
quotes.author: Homer

quotes.quote: Let death and exile and every other thing which appears dreadful be daily before your eyes; but most of all death: and you will never think of anything mean nor will you desire anything extravagantly.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: Some of the people who we think care that we hate them do not even care that there are people who love them.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Sometimes you find yourself so grateful that a prayer of yours was not answered that you pray that it be ignored. Just in case it is on the waiting list of prayers to be answered.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: A desired thing often comes with seeds of at least one desire.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: How does a person deal with all the heartache and tragedy that fills their life without becoming insane or committing suicide?
quotes.author: Kilroy J Oldster

quotes.quote: When you are unhappy, happy people are disgusting.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Sometimes silence is a sign, not of not knowing what to say, but of knowing when to say what you know.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: ...but if you think that only which is your own to be your own, and if you think that what is another’s, as it really is, belongs to another, no man will ever compel you, no man will hinder you, you will never blame any man, you will accuse no man, you will do nothing involuntarily (against your will), no man will harm you, you will have no enemy, for you will not suffer any harm.
quotes.author: Epicetus

quotes.quote: When you are alone, you should call this tranquility and freedom and when you are with many you shouldn’t call this a crowd, or trouble or uneasiness but festival and company and contentedly accept it.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: Poverty is greatly exaggerated by sanity.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: We get a taste of death, not when we’re asleep, but when we awake.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Like great ecologists, great pessimists make us see the beauty of death.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: We subconsciously wish that all of the things we hate but our enemies love were harmful.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Admitting that their child is, or can be, more educated than them is the closest most parents are willing to get to admitting that their child is, or can be, smarter or wiser than them.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: You will never see me surrender, never see me cry, but you will often see me walk away. Turn around and just leave, without looking back.
quotes.author: Charlotte Eriksson

quotes.quote: Soon, you will have forgotten everything. Soon, everybody will have forgotten you.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Sometimes, even to live is an act of courage.
quotes.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quotes.quote: The willing are led by fate, the reluctant are dragged.
quotes.author: Cleanthes of Assos

quotes.quote: In the evening I came home and read about the Messina earthquake, and how the relief ships arrived, and the wretched survivors crowded down to the water's edge and tore each other like wild beasts in their rage of hunger. The paper set forth, in horrified language, that some of them had been seventy-two hours without food. I, as I read, had also been seventy-two hours without food; and the difference was simply that they thought they were starving.
quotes.author: Upton Sinclair

quotes.quote: At dawn, when you have trouble getting out of bed, tell yourself, "I have to go to work - as a human being. What do I have to complain of, if I'm going to do what I was born for - the things I was brought into the world to do? Or is this what I was created for? To huddle under the blankets and stay warm?
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Being a stoic does not mean being a robot. Being a stoic means remaining calm both at the height of pleasure and the depths of misery.
quotes.author: Abhijit Naskar

quotes.quote: We might never rid ourselves of a lingering anxiety regarding our death; this is a kind of tax we pay in return for self-awareness.
quotes.author: Derren Brown

quotes.quote: You have the power to strip away many superfluous troubles located wholly in your judgement, and to possess a large room for yourself embracing in thought the whole cosmos, to consider everlasting time, to think of the rapid change in the parts of each thing, of how short it is from birth until dissolution, and how the void before birth and that after dissolution are equally infinite.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Everything worthwhile in your life draws its meaning from the fact you will die.
quotes.author: Derren Brown

quotes.quote: That which Fortune has not given, she cannot take away.
quotes.author: Seneca the Younger

quotes.quote: Life is how you look at it.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Yes, as my swift days near their goal, 'Tis all that I implore - In life and death, a chainless soul, With courage to endure.
quotes.author: Emily Brontë

quotes.quote: When others inspire us, they tend to do so through the clear expression of these sketchy, adumbrated thoughts we ourselves have known but never had the perspicacity for formulate with certainty.
quotes.author: Derren Brown

quotes.quote: Indulge the body just so far as suffices for good health. It needs to be treated somewhat strictly to prevent it from being disobedient to the spirit. Your food should appease your hunger, your drink quench your thirst, your clothing keep out the cold, your house be a protection against inclement weather.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Sometimes we have no luxury of choice. We must do certain things for survival. That should not stop us from doing the things we love.
quotes.author: Malebo Sephodi

quotes.quote: It takes courage to speak or react way slower than you think.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Just as I prepared to stand and bow, a woman appeared with a miniature coffee cup in her hand. She offered it to me. As I took it, I noticed two things: Bugs crawling on the ground and the men approving of me by snapping their fingers. I bowed and took a sip of the coffee and almost fainted. I had a cockroach on my tongue. I looked at the peoples' faces and I could not spit it out. My grandmother would have pushed away the grave's dirt and traveled by willpower to show me her face of abject disappointment. I could not bear that. I opened my throat and drank the cup dry. I counted four cockroaches.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: When you are disturbed by events and lose your serenity, quickly return to yourself and don't stay upset longer than the experience lasts; for you'll have more mastery over your inner harmony by continually returning to it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: The supreme ideal does not call for any external aids. It is homegrown, wholly self-developed. Once it starts looking outside itself for any part of itself it is on the way to being dominated by fortune.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: The man who looks for the morrow without worrying over it knows a peaceful independence and a happiness beyond all others. Whoever has said, "I have lived' receives a windfall every day he gets up in the morning.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Show me a man who though sick is happy, who though in danger is happy, who though in prison is happy, and I'll show you a Stoic.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: They did this to me but I have remained who I am. I am tempered. I am able. Inside myself there's an untouched man. If they came back now, and did everything to me again, they would never reach the untouched man. I've passed the exam I've been shirking all my life. I'm a graduate of pain.
quotes.author: John le Carré

quotes.quote: The Sage desires only one thing, virtue, and he is cautious about only one thing, vice. He is the same in every circumstance because what is most important lies within him, and not with external events, which are constantly changing.
quotes.author: Donald J. Robertson

quotes.quote: Perhaps struggle is all we have because the god of history is an atheist, and nothing about his world is meant to be. So you must wake up every morning knowing that no promise is unbreakable, least of all the promises of waking up at all. This is not despair. These are the preferences of universe itself: verbs over nouns, actions over states, struggle over hope.
quotes.author: Ta Nahesi Coates

quotes.quote: Making noble resolutions is not as important as keeping the resolutions you have made already. (Letter XVI)
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: The most fruitful breaks are often those we are or were forced to take by life.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Appreciating what you have is the best cure for missing what you have lost.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: If you haven’t learned something From periods of suffering, If you haven’t wrung the juices Of your own pain and drank them For your own nourishment, You have wasted your experience And missed the chance To expand the capacity For being stronger the next time That these seasons arrive at your door.
quotes.author: Eric Overby

quotes.quote: Soon you will be dead and none of it will matter
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: man was given two ears and one mouth for a reason
quotes.author: Account of The Stoic Zeno by Ryan Holiday and Stephen Haselman

quotes.quote: Remind yourself that what you love is mortal … at the very moment you are taking joy in something, present yourself with the opposite impressions. What harm is it, just when you are kissing your little child, to say: Tomorrow you will die, or to your friend similarly: Tomorrow one of us will go away, and we shall not see one another any more?
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: I sacrificed much to be where I am today, yet I will sacrifice much more to get to where I need to be someday.
quotes.author: Justus Wiezorek

quotes.quote: Part of patience is knowing your truth and staying loyal to it; you just can’t allow your face to betray what an attack on it actually makes you feel.
quotes.author: A.D. Aliwat

quotes.quote: Stoicism is designed to be medicine for the soul.
quotes.author: Ryan Holiday

quotes.quote: Run down the list of those who felt intense anger at something: the most famous, the most unfortunate, the most hated, the most whatever: Where is all that now? Smoke, dust, legend…or not even a legend. Think of all the examples. And how trivial the things we want so passionately are. An emotional response is a human response, I get it. I too have succumbed to emotion, more often than I care to admit. But it is also a futile response. It isn’t an objectively beneficial response. This is central to Stoicism.
quotes.author: Dan Crenshaw

quotes.quote: The media’s goal is to literally challenge your ability to be still. A tough American, intent on improving upon their current self, is not tricked into an emotional reaction by these headlines. You do not write an angry tweet, you do not hurl an insult. You are cool and measured, and skeptical. You are curious what the agenda of the journalist might be and what facts or context they might be leaving out. You seek out a different story on the same topic from an opposing view, and you find out that many of the claims made in the original story were convincingly debunked. And just like that, you are a Zen master of stillness and Stoicism.
quotes.author: Dan Crenshaw

quotes.quote: A shallow reading of a problem begets outrage; a detailed approach to a problem encourages moderation.
quotes.author: Dan Crenshaw

quotes.quote: You owe it to yourself and to the world to actively engage with the brief moment you have with this planet. You cannot retreat exclusively into ideas. You must contribute.
quotes.author: Ryan Holiday

quotes.quote: Asia and Europe are corners in the Universe; every sea, a drop in the Universe; Mount Athos, a clod of earth in the Universe; every instant of time, a pin-prick of eternity. All things are petty, easily changed, vanishing away. All things come from that other world, starting from that common governing principle, or else are secondary consequences of it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Education teaches us how to make a living, not how to live.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Like a problem, time is nothing but a shadow of thought.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Halleck came from people who regarded a slight change of facial expression as adequate to convey the pain of a severed limb.
quotes.author: Miles Watson

quotes.quote: A still person has the ability to stop, look at a news story or another person’s arguments, and ask objective questions without emotional overreaction or assumptions of ill intent. One is centered, rational, and respected; the other is frantic, unhappy, and intellectually stagnant. Don’t be the latter.
quotes.author: Dan Crenshaw

quotes.quote: See? You're using the stoic glacier method." "Remind me, what's the stoic glacier method?" "It's the slow process of shaping someone's behavior by force of one's own personal stoicism.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Mckenzie

quotes.quote: Life is a pilgrimage and a struggle. All we have of time is a moment; the universe is in constant flux; our bodies are fragile; our senses grasp so little; our souls are a mist; the future is a fog; and fame is fleeting.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: There was no meaning in why he was here, but he was, and that was enough.
quotes.author: AkshatThakur

quotes.quote: I have, I hold whatever of mine I have ever had. There is no reason for you to suppose me conquered and yourself my conqueror. It is your fortune which has overcome mine. As for those fleeting possessions which change their owners, I know not where they are; what belongs to myself is with me, and ever will be.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: Growth is often the cause or the result of pain.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Really, doesn't everything make sense? There are, of course, things from which we more or less recover, although some of them are too harsh even for saints. But that is no reason to accuse God. Even if there are reasons to doubt him, the fact that he did not arrange the world like a well-ordered parlor is not one of them. It rather speaks in his favor. This used to be much better understood.
quotes.author: Ernst Jünger

quotes.quote: A surprising number of people believe that other people can hurt their feelings.
quotes.author: Vincent P. Collins

quotes.quote: What progress, you ask, have I made? I have begun to be a friend to myself.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.quote: We love being mentally strong, but we hate situations that allow us to put our mental strength to good use.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Some of the best things that have ever happened to us wouldn’t have happened to us, if it weren’t for some of the worst things that have ever happened to us.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: Sick and yet happy, in peril and yet happy, dying and yet happy, in exile and happy, in disgrace and happy.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: We all have problems. Or rather, everyone has at least one thing that they regard as a problem.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: True affluence is not needing anything.
quotes.author: Gary Snyder

quotes.quote: Whatever happens, happens such as you are either formed by nature able to bear it, or not able to bear it. If such as you are by nature form’d able to bear, bear it and fret not: But if such as you are not naturally able to bear, don’t fret; for when it has consum’d you, itself will perish. Remember, however, you are by nature form’d able to bear whatever it is in the power of your own opinion to make supportable or tolerable, according as you conceive it advantageous, or your duty, to do so.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Death would not surprise us as often as it does, if we let go of the misbelief that newborns are less mortal than the elderly.
quotes.author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

quotes.quote: ...we can do some historical research to see how our ancestors lived. We will quickly discover that we are living in what to them would have been a dream world that we tend to take for granted things that our ancestors had to live without...
quotes.author: William B. Irvine

quotes.quote: Man is mostly a collection of emotions, most of which he would do better not to be feeling.
quotes.author: Neel Burton

quotes.quote: Progress daily in your own uncertainty. Live in awareness of the questions.
quotes.author: Bremer Acosta

quotes.quote: Life is neither a glorious highlight reel nor a monstrous tragedy. Every day is a good day to live and a good day to die. Every day is also an apt time to learn and express joy and love for the entire natural world. Each day is an apt time to make contact with other people and express empathy for the entire world. Each day is perfect to accept with indifference all aspects of being.
quotes.author: Kilroy J. Oldster

quotes.quote: Most of us are “living the dream” living, that is, the dream we once had for ourselves.
quotes.author: William B. Irvine

quotes.quote: And here are two of the most immediately useful thoughts you will dip into. First that things cannot touch the mind: they are external and inert; anxieties can only come from your internal judgement. Second, hat all these things you see will change almost as you look at them, and then will be no more. Constantly bring to mind all that you yourself have already seen changed. The universe is change: life is judgement.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Seek not for events to happen as you wish but rather wish for events to happen as they do and your life will go smoothly.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: The philosopher's lecture room is a 'hospital': you ought not to walk out of it in a state of pleasure, but in pain; for you are not in good condition when you arrive.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: There are two things that must be rooted out in human beings - arrogant opinion and mistrust. Arrogant opinion expects that there is nothing further needed, and mistrust assumes that under the torrent of circumstance there can be no happiness.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: What would Heracles have been if he had said, "How am I to prevent a big lion from appearing, or a big boar, or brutal men?" What care you, I say? If a big boar appears, you will have a greater struggle to engage in; if evil men appear, you will free the world from evil men.
