quotes.quote: Fear is pain arising from the anticipation of evil.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: For as the eyes of bats are to the blaze of day, so is the reason in our soul to the things which are by nature most evident of all.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: For one swallow does not make a summer, nor does one day; and so too one day, or a short time, does not make a man blessed and happy.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Friendship is essentially a partnership.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Good habits formed at youth make all the difference.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: He who is to be a good ruler must have first been ruled.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: He who is unable to live in society, or who has no need because he is sufficient for himself, must be either a beast or a god.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: I have gained this from philosophy: that I do without being commanded what others do only from fear of the law.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: If liberty and equality, as is thought by some, are chiefly to be found in democracy, they will be best attained when all persons alike share in government to the utmost.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: In a democracy the poor will have more power than the rich, because there are more of them, and the will of the majority is supreme.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: In nine cases out of ten, a woman had better show more affection than she feels.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: In poverty and other misfortunes of life, true friends are a sure refuge. The young they keep out of mischief; to the old they are a comfort and aid in their weakness, and those in the prime of life they incite to noble deeds.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Inferiors revolt in order that they may be equal, and equals that they may be superior. Such is the state of mind which creates revolutions.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: It is Homer who has chiefly taught other poets the art of telling lies skillfully.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: It is just that we should be grateful, not only to those with whose views we may agree, but also to those who have expressed more superficial views; for these also contributed something, by developing before us the powers of thought.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: It is not once nor twice but times without number that the same ideas make their appearance in the world.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: It is unbecoming for young men to utter maxims.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Jealousy is both reasonable and belongs to reasonable men, while envy is base and belongs to the base, for the one makes himself get good things by jealousy, while the other does not allow his neighbour to have them through envy.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Man is by nature a political animal.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Men acquire a particular quality by constantly acting in a particular way.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Men create gods after their own image, not only with regard to their form but with regard to their mode of life.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Misfortune shows those who are not really friends.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Most people would rather give than get affection.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Mothers are fonder than fathers of their children because they are more certain they are their own.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Nature does nothing in vain.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: No excellent soul is exempt from a mixture of madness.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: No notice is taken of a little evil, but when it increases it strikes the eye.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Of all the varieties of virtues, liberalism is the most beloved.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Personal beauty is a greater recommendation than any letter of reference.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Piety requires us to honor truth above our friends.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Poetry is finer and more philosophical than history; for poetry expresses the universal, and history only the particular.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Politicians also have no leisure, because they are always aiming at something beyond political life itself, power and glory, or happiness.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Probable impossibilities are to be preferred to improbable possibilities.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Quality is not an act, it is a habit.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Republics decline into democracies and democracies degenerate into despotisms.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Suffering becomes beautiful when anyone bears great calamities with cheerfulness, not through insensibility but through greatness of mind.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The aim of art is to represent not the outward appearance of things, but their inward significance.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The aim of the wise is not to secure pleasure, but to avoid pain.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The beginning of reform is not so much to equalize property as to train the noble sort of natures not to desire more, and to prevent the lower from getting more.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The best friend is the man who in wishing me well wishes it for my sake.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The end of labor is to gain leisure.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The generality of men are naturally apt to be swayed by fear rather than reverence, and to refrain from evil rather because of the punishment that it brings than because of its own foulness.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The gods too are fond of a joke.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The greatest virtues are those which are most useful to other persons.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The ideal man bears the accidents of life with dignity and grace, making the best of circumstances.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The least initial deviation from the truth is multiplied later a thousandfold.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The moral virtues, then, are produced in us neither by nature nor against nature. Nature, indeed, prepares in us the ground for their reception, but their complete formation is the product of habit.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The most perfect political community is one in which the middle class is in control, and outnumbers both of the other classes.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The one exclusive sign of thorough knowledge is the power of teaching.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: "I swear that what I went through, no animal would have gone through." This sentence, the noblest ever spoken, this sentence that defines man's place in the universe, that honors him, that re-establishes the true hierarchy, floated back into my thoughts.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: A chief is a man who assumes responsibility. He says, 'I was beaten.' He does not say, 'My men were beaten.'
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: A child is not frightened at the thought of being patiently transmuted into an old man.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: A civilization is a heritage of beliefs, customs, and knowledge slowly accumulated in the course of centuries, elements difficult at times to justify by logic, but justifying themselves as paths when they lead somewhere, since they open up for man his inner distance.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: A man's age represents a fine cargo of experiences and memories.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: A rock pile ceases to be a rock pile the moment a single man contemplates it, bearing within him the image of a cathedral.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: A sky as pure as water bathed the stars and brought them out.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Although human life is priceless, we always act as if something had an even greater price than life... But what is that something?
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: An administration, like a machine, does not create. It carries on.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Confuse not love with the raptures of possession, which bring the cruelest of sufferings. For, notwithstanding the general opinion, love does not cause suffering: what causes it is the sense of ownership, which is love's opposite.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Each man must look to himself to teach him the meaning of life. It is not something discovered: it is something moulded.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Flowers are weak creatures. They are naive. They reassure themselves as best they can. They believe that their thorns are terrible weapons.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: For you live not by things, but by the meaning of things.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Grown-ups never understand anything by themselves, and it is tiresome for children to be always and forever explaining things to them.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: He who bears in his heart a cathedral to be built is already victorious.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: He who is different from me does not impoverish me - he enriches me. Our unity is constituted in something higher than ourselves - in Man... For no man seeks to hear his own echo, or to find his reflection in the glass.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: How does life construct those lines of force which make us alive?
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: If it is true that wars are won by believers, it is also true that peace treaties are sometimes signed by businessmen.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: If you want to understand the meaning of happiness, you must see it as a reward and not as a goal.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: In a civil war the firing line is invisible, it passes through the hearts of men.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: It is another of the miraculous things about mankind that there is no pain nor passion that does not radiate to the ends of the earth. Let a man in a garret but burn with enough intensity and he will set fire to the world.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: It is in your act that you exist, not in your body. Your act is yourself, and there is no other you.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: It seems that perfection is attained not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing more to remove.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Night, the beloved. Night, when words fade and things come alive. When the destructive analysis of day is done, and all that is truly important becomes whole and sound again. When man reassembles his fragmentary self and grows with the calm of a tree.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: No single event can awaken within us a stranger totally unknown to us. To live is to be slowly born. It would be a bit too easy if we could go about borrowing ready-made souls.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Nobody grasped you by the shoulder while there was still time. Now the clay of which you were shaped has dried and hardened, and naught in you will ever awaken the sleeping musician, the poet, the astronomer that possibly inhabited you in the beginning.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: One can be a brother only in something. Where there is no tie that binds men, men are not united but merely lined up.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Only the unknown frightens men. But once a man has faced the unknown, that terror becomes the known.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Peace dies when the framework is ripped apart. When there is no longer a place that is yours in the world. When you know no longer where your friend is to be found.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The quest for riches darkens the sense of right and wrong.
quotes.author: Antiphanes

quotes.quote: A man can hide all things, excepting twain – that he is drunk, and that he in love.
quotes.author: Antiphanes

quotes.quote: Real miracles make little noise! Essential events are so simple!
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The dignity of the individual demands that he be not reduced to vassalage by the largess of others.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The essential, most often, has no weight. The essential there, was apparently nothing but a smile. A smile is often the essential. One is paid with a smile. One is rewarded by a smile. And the quality of a smile might make one die.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The field of consciousness is tiny. It accepts only one problem at a time. Get into a fist fight, put your mind on the strategy of the fight, and you will not feel the other fellow's punches.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The injustice of defeat lies in the fact that its most innocent victims are made to look like heartless accomplices.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The machine does not isolate us from the great problems of nature but plunges us more deeply into them.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The meaning of things lies not in the things themselves but in our attitude toward them.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The notion of looking on at life has always been hateful to me. What am I if I am not a participant? In order to be, I must participate.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The seed haunted by the sun never fails to find its way between the stones in the ground. And the pure logician, if no sun draws him forth, remains entangled in his logic.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: The thing that is important is the thing that is not seen.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: To be a man is to be responsible: to be ashamed of miseries you did not cause; to be proud of your comrades' victories; to be aware, when setting one stone, that you are building a world.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: To give you an idea of the size of the Earth, I will tell you that before the invention of electricity it was necessary to maintain, over the whole of the six continents, a veritable army of 462,511 lamplighters for the street lamps.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Transport of the mails, transport of the human voice, transport of flickering pictures — in this century, as in others, our highest accomplishments still have the single aim of bringing men together.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Treason implies responsibility for something, control over something, influence upon something, knowledge of something. Treason in our time is a proof of genius. Why, I want to know, are not traitors decorated?
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: War is not an adventure. It is a disease. It is like typhus.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Water, thou hast no taste, no color, no odor; canst not be defined, art relished while ever mysterious. Not necessary to life, but rather life itself, thou fillest us with a gratification that exceeds the delight of the senses.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: We say nothing essential about the cathedral when we speak of its stones. We say nothing essential about Man when we seek to define him by the qualities of men.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: When the body sinks into death, the essence of man is revealed. Man is a knot, a web, a mesh into which relationships are tied. Only those relationships matter. The body is an old crock that nobody will miss. I have never known a man to think of himself when dying. Never.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Your task is not to foresee the future, but to enable it.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: If you want to build a ship, don't drum up people together to collect wood and don't assign them tasks and work, but rather teach them to long for the endless immensity of the sea.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Freedom and constraint are two aspects of the same necessity, the necessity of being the man you are and not another. You are free to be that man, but not another.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: And now here is my secret, a very simple secret; it is only with the heart that one can see rightly, what is essential is invisible to the eye.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: To live is to be slowly born.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: One sees clearly only with the heart. Anything essential is invisible to the eyes.
quotes.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

quotes.quote: Man is what he believes.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: When people are ashamed they hold aloof, above all from those nearest to them.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: Man will become better only when you will make him see what he is like.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: If in the first act you have hung a pistol on the wall, then in the following one it should be fired. Otherwise don't put it there.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: Love, friendship, respect do not unite people as much as common hatred for something.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: You must trust and believe in people or life becomes impossible.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: An artist observes, selects, guesses, and synthesizes.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: He who desires nothing, hopes for nothing, and is afraid of nothing, cannot be an artist.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: One must be a god to be able to tell successes from failures without making a mistake.
quotes.author: Anton Chekhov

quotes.quote: Wise people, even though all laws were abolished, would still lead the same life.
quotes.author: Aristophanes

quotes.quote: Under every stone lurks a politician.
quotes.author: Aristophanes

quotes.quote: Let each man exercise the art he knows.
quotes.author: Aristophanes

quotes.quote: The ultimate value of life depends upon awareness and the power of contemplation rather than upon mere survival.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The virtue of justice consists in moderation, as regulated by wisdom.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The whole is more than the sum of its parts.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The wise man does not expose himself needlessly to danger, since there are few things for which he cares sufficiently; but he is willing, in great crises, to give even his life - knowing that under certain conditions it is not worthwhile to live.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The worst form of inequality is to try to make unequal things equal.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The young are permanently in a state resembling intoxication.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Therefore, the good of man must be the end of the science of politics.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Those who excel in virtue have the best right of all to rebel, but then they are of all men the least inclined to do so.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: We must no more ask whether the soul and body are one than ask whether the wax and the figure impressed on it are one.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: What it lies in our power to do, it lies in our power not to do.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: What the statesman is most anxious to produce is a certain moral character in his fellow citizens, namely a disposition to virtue and the performance of virtuous actions.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Wit is educated insolence.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: You will never do anything in this world without courage. It is the greatest quality of the mind next to honor.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Youth is easily deceived because it is quick to hope.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: No great mind has ever existed without a touch of madness.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Persuasion is achieved by the speaker's personal character when the speech is spoken as to make us think him credible. We believe good men more fully and more readily than others. This is true generally whatever the question is, and absolutely true where exact certainty is impossible and opinions are divided.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The life of money-making is one undertaken under compulsion, and wealth is evidently not the good we are seeking; for it is merely useful and for the sake of something else.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The more you know, the more you know you don't know.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Our actions determine our dispositions.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: If you would understand anything, observe its beginning and its development.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Moral virtues we acquire through practice like the arts.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: Art completes what nature cannot bring to finish. The artist gives us knowledge of nature's unrealized ends.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.quote: The only way of finding the limits of the possible is by going beyond them into the impossible.
quotes.author: Arthur C. Clarke

quotes.quote: Sometimes I think we're alone in the universe, and sometimes I think we're not. In either case, the idea is quite staggering.
quotes.author: Arthur C. Clarke

quotes.quote: I don't pretend we have the answers. But the questions are certainly worth thinking about.
quotes.author: Arthur C. Clarke

quotes.quote: Men go abroad to wonder at the height of mountains, at the huge waves of the sea, at the long courses of the rivers, at the vast compass of the ocean, at the circular motion of the stars; and they pass by themselves with out wondering.
quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo

quotes.quote: Seek not to understand that you may believe, but believe that you may understand.
quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo

quotes.quote: A free curiosity has more efficiency in learning than a frightful enforcement.
quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo

quotes.quote: Habit, if not resisted, soon becomes necessity.
quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo

quotes.quote: Pride changes angels into devils, humility makes man into angels.
quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo

quotes.quote: Neither your wisdom be with pride, nor your humility without wisdom.
quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo

quotes.quote: Necessity knows no law.
quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo

quotes.quote: Prudence is the knowledge of what is to be sought and what is to be avoided.
quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo

quotes.quote: The verdict of the world is conclusive.
quotes.author: Augustine Of Hippo

quotes.quote: Bad company is like a nail driven into a post, which, after the first and second blow, may be drawn out with little difficulty; but being once driven up to the head, the pincers cannot take hold to draw it out, but which can only be done by the destruction of the wood.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: Do you wish to be great? Then begin by being. Do you desire to construct a vast and lofty fabric? Think first about the foundations of humility. The higher your structure is to be, the deeper must be its foundation.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: Do you wish to rise? Begin by descending. You plan a tower that will pierce the clouds? Lay first the foundation of humility.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: Faith is to believe what you do not see; the reward of this faith is to see what you believe.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: Give me chastity and continence, but not yet.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: Humility is the foundation of all the other virtues hence, in the soul in which this virtue does not exist there cannot be any other virtue except in mere appearance.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: If two friends ask you to judge a dispute, don't accept, because you will lose one friend; on the other hand, if two strangers come with the same request, accept because you will gain one friend.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: Pray as though everything depended on God. Work as though everything depended on you.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: Resentment is like drinking poison and waiting for the other person to die.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: Since you cannot do good to all, you are to pay special attention to those who, by the accidents of time, or place, or circumstances, are brought into closer connection with you.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: This is the very perfection of a man, to find out his own imperfections.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: What does love look like? It has the hands to help others. It has the feet to hasten to the poor and needy. It has eyes to see misery and want. It has the ears to hear the sighs and sorrows of men. That is what love looks like.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: Love is the beauty of the soul.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: A word too much always defeats its purpose.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: It is with trifles, and when he is off guard, that a man best reveals his character.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Ignorance is degrading only when found in company with riches.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: To desire immortality is to desire the eternal perpetuation of great mistake.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Intellect is invisible to the man who has none.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: With people of only moderate ability, modesty is mere honesty; but with those who possess great talent, it is hypocrisy.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Ordinary people think merely how they will spend their time, a man of intellect tries to use it.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: We forfeit three-fourths of ourselves in order to be like other people.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Happiness belongs to those who are sufficient unto themselves. For all external sources of happiness and pleasure are, by their very nature, highly uncertain, precarious, ephemeral, and subject to chance.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: A man can be himself only so long as he is alone, and if he does not love solitude, he will not love freedom, for it is only when he is alone that he is really free.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: All truth passes through three stages. First, it is ridiculed. Second, it is violently opposed. Third, it is accepted as being self-evident.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Almost all of our sorrows spring out of our relations with other people.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Change alone is eternal, perpetual, immortal.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Friends and acquaintances are the surest passport to fortune.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Great men are like eagles, and build their nest on some lofty solitude.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Great minds are related to the brief span of time during which they live as great buildings are to a little square in which they stand: you cannot see them in all their magnitude because you are standing too close to them.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: I've never known any trouble than an hour's reading didn't assuage.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Just remember, once you're over the hill you begin to pick up speed.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Nature shows that with the growth of intelligence comes increased capacity for pain, and it is only with the highest degree of intelligence that suffering reaches its supreme point.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Opinion is like a pendulum and obeys the same law. If it goes past the centre of gravity on one side, it must go a like distance on the other; and it is only after a certain time that it finds the true point at which it can remain at rest.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Politeness is to human nature what warmth is to wax.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Rascals are always sociable, more's the pity! and the chief sign that a man has any nobility in his character is the little pleasure he takes in others' company.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Religion is the masterpiece of the art of animal training, for it trains people as to how they shall think.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: The alchemists in their search for gold discovered many other things of greater value.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: The discovery of truth is prevented more effectively, not by the false appearance things present and which mislead into error, not directly by weakness of the reasoning powers, but by preconceived opinion, by prejudice.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: The doctor sees all the weakness of mankind; the lawyer all the wickedness, the theologian all the stupidity.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: The first forty years of life give us the text; the next thirty supply the commentary on it.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: The greatest achievements of the human mind are generally received with distrust.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: The two enemies of human happiness are pain and boredom.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Treat a work of art like a prince. Let it speak to you first.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: Will minus intellect constitutes vulgarity.

quotes.quote: A good martial artist does not become tense, but ready. Not thinking, yet not dreaming. Ready for whatever may come. When the opponent expands, I contract; and when he contracts, I expand. And when there is an opportunity, "I" do not hit, "it" hits all by itself.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: A good teacher can never be fixed in a routine... each moment requires a sensitive mind that is constantly changing and constantly adapting. A teacher must never impose this student to fit his favourite pattern; a good teacher functions as a pointer, exposing his student's vulnerability (and) causing him to explore both internally and finally integrating himself with his being. Martial art should not be passed out indiscriminately.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: A quality martial artist is always ready for any move, and trains oneself invincible.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: A self-willed man obeys a different law, the one law I, too, hold absolutely sacred — the human law in himself, his own individual will.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Action is a high road to self-confidence and esteem. Where it is open, all energies flow toward it. It comes readily to most people, and its rewards are tangible.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: All types of knowledge, ultimately mean self knowledge.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: An instructor should exemplify the things he seeks to teach. It will be of great advantage if you yourself can do all you ask of your students and more.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: An intelligent mind is an inquiring mind. It is not satisfied with explanation, with conclusions. Nor is it a mind that believes, because belief is again another form of conclusion.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Anxiety is the gap between the NOW and the THEN. So if you are in the NOW, you can't be anxious, because your excitement flows immediately into ongoing spontaneous activity.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Any technique, however worthy and desirable, becomes a disease when the mind is obsessed with it.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Art calls for complete mastery of techniques, developed by reflection within the soul.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Art reaches its greatest peak when devoid of self-consciousness. Freedom discovers man the moment he loses concern over what impression he is making or about to make.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: As an instructor, you must be able to distinguish between poor performance caused by lack of ability or aptitude on the part of the student and poor performance caused by lack of effort. You should treat the first with patience and the latter with firmness. You must never apply sarcasm and ridicule.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: As long as we separate this oneness into two we won't achieve realization.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Balance your thoughts with action. If you spend too much time thinking about a thing, you'll never get it done.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Be aware of doing your best to understand the ROOT in life, and realize the DIRECT and the INDIRECT are in fact a complementary WHOLE. It is to see things as they are and not to become attached to anything — to be unconscious meant to be be innocent of the working of a relative (empirical) mind — where there is no abiding of though anywhere on anything — this is being unbound. This not abiding anywhere is the root of our life.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Believe me that in every big thing or achievement there are always obstacles-big or small- and the reaction one shows to such obstacles is what counts, not the obstacle itself.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Concentration is the ROOT of all the higher abilities in man.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Conditioning obstructs our view of reality. We do not see IT in its suchness because of our indoctrination, crooked and twisted.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Defeat is not defeat unless accepted as a reality-in your own mind.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Defense is attack, attack is defense, each being the cause and result of the other.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Do not allow negative thoughts to enter your mind for they are the weeds that strangle confidence.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Do not deny the classical approach, simply as a reaction, or you will have created another pattern and trapped yourself there.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Do not have an attitude, open yourself and focus yourself and express yourself. Reject external form that fails to express internal reality.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Don't be forecasting evil unless it is what you can guard against. Anxiety is good for nothing if we can't turn it into a defense.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Don't fear failure. Not failure, but low aim, is the crime. In great attempts it is glorious even to fail.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Don't get set into one form, adapt it and build your own, and let it grow, be like water. Empty your mind, be formless, shapeless — like water. Now you put water in a cup, it becomes the cup; You put water into a bottle it becomes the bottle; You put it in a teapot it becomes the teapot. Now water can flow or it can crash. Be water, my friend.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Don't think, feel.. it is like a finger pointing a way to the moon. Don't concentrate on the finger or you will miss all that heavenly glory!
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Emptiness the starting point. In order to taste my cup of water you must first empty your cup. My friend, drop all your preconceived and fixed ideas and be neutral. Do you know why this cup is useful? Because it is empty.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Even today, I dare not say that I have reached a state of achievement. I'm still learning, for learning is boundless.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Everybody has to think for himself. A right way for a big man may not be a right way for a small man. A right way for someone who is slow may not be a right way for someone who is quick. Each person must understand his weaknesses and his strengths.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Faith makes it possible to achieve that which man's mind can conceive and believe.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Flow in the living moment - We are always in a process of becoming and nothing is fixed.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: For it is easy to criticize and break down the spirit of others, but to know yourself takes a lifetime.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Forget about winning and losing; forget about pride and pain. Let your opponent graze your skin and you smash into his flesh; let him smash into your flesh and you fracture his bones; let him fracture your bones and you take his life. Do not be concerned with escaping safely — lay your life before him.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Genius: The capacity to see and to express what is simple, simply!
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Give up thinking as though not giving it up. Observe techniques as though not observing.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Have no rigid system in you, and you'll be flexible to change with the ever changing.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: He who wants to succeed should learn how to fight, to strive and to suffer. You can acquire a lot in life, if you are prepared to give up a lot to get it.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Here I am as a human being...how can I express myself, totally and completely?
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Humility forms the basis of honor, just as the low ground forms the foundation of a high elevation.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: I don't know what is the meaning of death, but I am not afraid to die - and I go on, non-stop, going forward [with life]. Even though I, Bruce Lee, may die some day without fulfilling all of my ambitions, I will have no regrets. I did what I wanted to do and what I've done, I've done with sincerity and to the best of my ability. You can't expect much more from life.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: I have always been a martial artist by choice, an actor by profession, but above all, am actualising myself to be an artist of life.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: I have the absolute confidence not to be number two, but then I have enough sense to realize that there can be no number one.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: I personally do not believe in the word style. Why? Because, unless there are human beings with three arms and four legs, unless we have another group of human beings that are structurally different from us, there can be no different style of fighting.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: If every man would help his neighbor, no man would be without help.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: If I tell you I'm good, probably you will say I'm boasting. But if I tell you I'm not good, you'll know I'm lying.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: If nothing within you stays rigid, outward things will disclose themselves. Moving, be like water. Still, be like a mirror. Respond like an echo.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: If one loves, one need not have an ideology of love.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: If there is always light, you don't experience light anymore. You have to have the rhythm of light and darkness.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: If you don't want to slip up tomorrow, speak the truth today.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: If you want to do your duty properly, you should do just a little more than that.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: If your opponent is at a distance, kick him in the groin. If he gets close, poke him in the eyes, bring up your knee, pop him with an elbow, dig a corkscrew punch to his stomach.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: In Buddhism, there is no place for using effort. Just be ordinary and nothing special. Eat your food, move your bowels, pass water and when you're tired go and lie down. The ignorant will laugh at me, but the wise will understand.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: In order to control myself I must first accept myself by going with and not against my nature.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: In order to realize our true self we must be willing to live without being dependent upon the opinion of others.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: It is easy for me to put on a show and be cocky... but to express oneself honestly not lying to oneself, now that my friend is very hard to do.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: It is not a shame to be knocked down by other people. The important thing is to ask when you're being knocked down, 'Why am I being knocked down?' If a person can reflect in this way, then there is hope for this person.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: It is useless to try to stir the dirt Out of the muddy water, As it will become murkier. But leave it alone, And if it should be cleared; It will become clear by itself.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Know the difference between a catastrophe and an inconvenience. To realize that it's just an inconvenience, that it is not a catastrophe, but just an unpleasantness, is part of coming into your own, part of waking up.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Knowledge will give you power, but character respect.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Knowledge, surely, is always of time, whereas knowing is not of time. Knowledge is from a source, from accumulation, from conclusion, while knowing is a movement.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Learning is never cumulative, it is a movement of knowing which has no beginning and no end.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Let the spirit out - Discard all thoughts of reward, all hopes of praise and fears of blame, all awareness of one's bodily self. And, finally closing the avenues of sense perception, let the spirit out, as it will.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Life is never stagnation. It is constant movement, unrhythmic movement, as we as constant change. Things live by moving and gain strength as they go.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Life is wide, limitless. There is no border, no frontier.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Life itself is your teacher, and you are in a state of constant learning.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Life lives; and in the living flow, no questions are raised. The reason is that life is a living now! So, in order to live life whole-heartedly, the answer is life simply is.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Like everyone else, you want to learn the way to win, but never to accept the way to lose - to accept defeat. To learn to die is to be liberated from it. So when tomorrow comes you must free your ambitious mind and learn the art of dying!
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Loneliness is only an opportunity to cut adrift and find yourself. In solitude you are least alone.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Love is like a friendship caught on fire. In the beginning a flame, very pretty, often hot and fierce, but still only light and flickering. As love grows older, our hearts mature and our love becomes as coals, deep-burning and unquenchable.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Make at least one definite move daily toward your goal.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Man, the living creature, the creating individual, is always more important than any established style or system.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Many people dedicate their lives to actualizing a concept of what they should be like, rather than actualizing themselves. This difference between self-actualization and self-image actualization is very important. Most people live only for their image.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Maturation is the development from environmental support to self-support.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Meaning is found in relationship. Meaning is the relationship of the foreground figure to the background.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: More and more I believe in the fact that you have two hands and two legs, and the thing is how to make good use of yourself - and that's about it.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Never waste energy on worries or negative thoughts, all problems are brought into existence -drop them.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Now I see that I will never find the light Unless, like the candle, I am my own fuel, Consuming myself.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Nowadays you don't go around on the street kicking people, punching people — because if you do (makes gun shape with hand), well that's it — I don't care how good you are.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: One must be truthful and honest in his approach; a constant independent inquiry and not blindly following a certain blue print laid down by others.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: One should be in harmony with, not in opposition to, the strength and force of the opposition. This means that one should do nothing that is not natural or spontaneous; the important thing is not to strain in any way.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: One will never get any more than he thinks he can get. YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES. Look back and see your progress - damn the torpedo, full speed ahead!
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Only the self-sufficient stand alone - most people follow the crowd and imitate.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: People try to hold onto the sameness. This holding onto prevents growth.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Persistence, persistence, and persistence. The Power can be created and maintained through daily practice - continuous effort.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Practice makes perfect. After a long time of practicing, our work will become natural, skillful, swift, and steady.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Prosperity is apt to prevent us from examining our conduct; but adversity leads us to think properly of our state, and so is beneficial to us.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Put 'going the extra mile' to work as part of one's daily habit.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Reality is apparent when one ceases to compare. There is "what is" only when there is no comparison at all, and to live with what is, is to be peaceful.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Reality is being itself. It is being itself, in becoming itself. Reality in its isness, the "isness" of a thing. Thus isness is the meaning — having freedom in its primary sense — not limited by attachments, confinements, partialization, complexities.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Recognizing that the power of will is the supreme court over all other departments of my mind, I will exercise daily when I need the urge to act for any purpose; and I will form habits designed to bring the power of my will into action at least once daily.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Relationship is the mirror in which you discover yourself - to be is to be related.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Remember my friend to enjoy your planning as well as your accomplishment, for life is too short for negative energy.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Running water never grows stale. So you just have to 'keep on flowing.'
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Satori - in the awakening from a dream. Awakening and self-realization and seeing into one's own being - these are synonymous.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Seek to understand the root. It is futile to argue as to which single leaf, which design of branch, or which attractive flower you like; when you understand the root, you understand all its blossoming.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Since life is an ever evolving process, one should flow in this process and discover how to actualize and expand oneself.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Since weight training involves repetitions, a great deal of energy must be exerted. Therefore, weight training should be practiced only every other day.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Sincere thought means thought of concentration (quiet awareness). The thought of a distracted mind cannot be sincere.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Sorrows are our best educator. A man can see further through a tear than a telescope.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Stop wasting time in playing a role or a concept. Instead, learn to ACTUALIZE YOURSELF, your potential.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Take inventory of everyone with whom you have contact.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The abdominal and waist region coordinate all parts of the body and act as the center or generator. Therefore, you can promote the ability to control the body's action and master your will more easily.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The consciousness of self is the greatest hindrance to the proper execution of all physical action.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The great mistake is to anticipate the outcome of the engagement; you ought not to be thinking of whether it ends in victory or defeat. Let nature take its course, and your tools will strike at the right moment.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The happiness that is derived from excitement is like a brilliant fire — soon it will go out. Before we married, we never had the chance to go out to nightclubs. We only spent our nights watching TV and chatting. Many young couples live a very exciting life when they are in love. So, when they marry, and their lives are reduced to calmness and dullness, they will feel impatient and will drink the bitter cup of a sad marriage.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The intangible represents the real power of the universe. It is the seed of the tangible.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The man who is really serious, with the urge to find out what truth is, has no style at all. He lives only in what is.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The meaning of life is that it is to be lived, and it is not to be traded and conceptualized and squeezed into a pattern of systems.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The measure of the moral worth of a man is his happiness. The better the man, the more happiness. Happiness is the synonym of well-being.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The Moment is freedom. I couldn't live by a rigid schedule. I try to live freely from moment to moment, letting things happen and adjusting to them.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The Now is indivisible. Completeness, the now, is an absence of the conscious mind to strive to divide that which is indivisible. For once the completeness of things is taken apart it is no longer complete.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The point is the doing of them rather than the accomplishments. There is no actor but the action; there is no experiencer but the experience.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The primary reality is not what I think, but that I live, for those also live who do not think.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The spirit of the individual is determined by his dominating thought habits.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The stillness in stillness is not the real stillness; only when there is stillness in movement does the universal rhythm manifest.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The success of an assailant's attack depends on surprise, and if you're sufficiently alert to prevent a surprise, your counterattack is already halfway to being successful.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The timeless moment. The "moment" has no yesterday or tomorrow. It is not the result of thought and therefore has no time.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The unfolding of the bare human soul...that is what interests me.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: The world is full of people who are determined to be somebody or to give trouble. They want to get ahead, to stand out. Such ambition has no use for a gung fu man, who rejects all forms of self-assertiveness and competition.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: There is no such thing as maturity. There is instead an ever-evolving process of maturing. Because when there is a maturity, there is a conclusion and a cessation. That's the end. That's when the coffin is closed. You might be deteriorating physically in the long process of aging, but your personal process of daily discovery is ongoing. You continue to learn more and more about yourself every day.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Those who are unaware they are walking in darkness will never seek the light.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Through my own observations. I am convinced that an absolutely honest and direct inquiry into oneself will lead to understanding.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: To be bound by traditional martial art style or styles is the way of the mindless, enslaved martial artist. But to be inspired by the traditional martial art and to achieve further heights is the way of genius.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: To be certain, every day there can be a revelation or a new discovery.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: To be what I term a 'quality' human being one has to be transparently real and have the courage to be what he is.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: To become a champion requires a good mental attitude toward preparation. You have to accept the most tedious task with pleasure.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: To contemplate a thing implies maintaining oneself OUTSIDE it, resolved to keep a distance between it and ourselves.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: To live is a constant process of relating, so come on out of that shell of isolation and conclusion, and relate DIRECTLY to what is being said. Bear in mind I seek neither your approval nor to influence you. So do not make up your mind as to "this is this" or "that is that." I will be more than satisfied if you begin to learn to investigate everything yourself from now on.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: One good thing about music, when it hits you, you feel no pain.
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: A bad strategy will fail no matter how good your information is and lame execution will stymie a good strategy. If you do enough things poorly, you will go out of business.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Once you embrace unpleasant news, not as a negative but as evidence of a need for change, you aren't defeated by it. You're learning from it.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: You've got to be willing to read other people's code, and then write your own, then have other people review your code. You've got to want to be in this incredible feedback loop where you get the world-class people to tell you what you're doing wrong...
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: I failed in some subjects in exam, but my friend passed in all. Now he is an engineer in Microsoft and I am the owner of Microsoft.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: I studied every thing but never topped... But today the toppers of the best universities are my employees.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Most people overestimate what they can do in one year and underestimate what they can do in ten years.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: I choose a lazy person to do a hard job. Because a lazy person will find an easy way to do it.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Be nice to nerds. Chances are you'll end up working for one.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Life's not fair, get over it!
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: In china when you're one in a million, there are 1300 people just like you.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: The world won't care about your self-esteem. The world will expect you to accomplish something BEFORE you feel good about yourself.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: If you think your teacher is tough, wait till you get a boss.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Flipping burgers is not beneath your dignity. Your Grandparents had a different word for burger flipping -- they called it opportunity.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Television is NOT real life. In real life people actually have to leave the coffee shop and go to jobs.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Life is not divided into semesters. You don't get summers off and very few employers are interested in helping you FIND YOURSELF. Do that on your own time.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Patience is a key element of success.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Technology is just a tool. In terms of getting the kids working together and motivating them, the teacher is the most important.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: If I'd had some set idea of a finish line, don't you think I would have crossed it years ago?
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Measuring programming progress by lines of code is like measuring aircraft building progress by weight.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Microsoft's only factory asset is the human imagination.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: The Internet? We are not interested in it.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: We are always saying to ourself...we have to innovate. We've got to come up with that breakthrough.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: The first rule of any technology used in a business is that automation applied to an efficient operation will magnify the efficiency. The second is that automation applied to an inefficient operation will magnify the inefficiency.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: We all need people who will give us feedback. That's how we improve.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: I actually thought that it would be a little confusing during the same period of your life to be in one meeting when you're trying to make money, and then go to another meeting where you're giving it away. I mean is it gonna erode your ability, you know, to make money? Are you gonna somehow get confused about what you're trying to do?
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: I believe in innovation and that the way you get innovation is you fund research and you learn the basic facts.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Everyone needs a coach. It doesn't matter whether you're a basketball player, a tennis player, a gymnast or a bridge player.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Software innovation, like almost every other kind of innovation, requires the ability to collaborate and share ideas with other people, and to sit down and talk with customers and get their feedback and understand their needs.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Headlines, in a way, are what mislead you because bad news is a headline, and gradual improvement is not.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: I really had a lot of dreams when I was a kid, and I think a great deal of that grew out of the fact that I had a chance to read a lot.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: In business, the idea of measuring what you are doing, picking the measurements that count like customer satisfaction and performance... you thrive on that.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: What's amazing is, if young people understood how doing well in school makes the rest of their life so much interesting, they would be more motivated. It's so far away in time that they can't appreciate what it means for their whole life.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Expectations are a form of first-class truth: If people believe it, it's true.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Since when has the world of computer software design been about what people want? This is a simple question of evolution. The day is quickly coming when every knee will bow down to a silicon fist, and you will all beg your binary gods for mercy.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: If you've found some way to educate yourself about engineering, stocks, or whatever it is, good employers will have some type of exam or interview and see a sample of your work.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: I don't think culture is something you can describe.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: At Microsoft there are lots of brilliant ideas but the image is that they all come from the top - I'm afraid that's not quite right.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: Whether it's Google or Apple or free software, we've got some fantastic competitors and it keeps us on our toes.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: If your culture doesn't like geeks, you are in real trouble.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: The most amazing philanthropists are people who are actually making a significant sacrifice.
quotes.author: Bill Gates
