quotes.quote: The only end of writing is to enable the readers better to enjoy life, or better to endure it.
quotes.author: Samuel Johnson

quotes.quote: A fellow will hack half a year at a block of marble to make something in stone that hardly resembles a man. The value of statuary is owing to its difficulty. You would not value the finest head cut upon a carrot.
quotes.author: Samuel Johnson

quotes.quote: I feel there's an existential angst among young people. I didn't have that. They see enormous mountains, where I only saw one little hill to climb.
quotes.author: Sergey Brin

quotes.quote: The kind of environment that we developed Google in, the reason that we were able to develop a search engine, is the web was so open. Once you get too many rules, that will stifle innovation.
quotes.author: Sergey Brin

quotes.quote: You always hear the phrase, money doesn't buy you happiness. But I always in the back of my mind figured a lot of money will buy you a little bit of happiness. But it's not really true. I got a new car because the old one's lease expired.
quotes.author: Sergey Brin

quotes.quote: Obviously everyone wants to be successful, but I want to be looked back on as being very innovative, very trusted and ethical and ultimately making a big difference in the world.
quotes.author: Sergey Brin

quotes.quote: Some say Google is God. Others say Google is Satan. But if they think Google is too powerful, remember that with search engines unlike other companies, all it takes is a single click to go to another search engine.
quotes.author: Sergey Brin

quotes.quote: I would like to see anyone be able to achieve their dreams, and that's what this organization does.
quotes.author: Sergey Brin

quotes.quote: Once you go from 10 people to 100, you already don't know who everyone is. So at that stage you might as well keep growing, to get the advantages of scale.
quotes.author: Sergey Brin

quotes.quote: Being entirely honest with oneself is a good exercise.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.quote: The goal of life is death.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.quote: "Anxiety" describes a particular state of expecting the danger or preparing for it, even though it may be an unknown one. "Fear" requires a definite object of which to be afraid.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.quote: The aim of psychoanalysis is to relieve people of their neurotic unhappiness so that they can be normally unhappy.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.quote: Illusions commend themselves to us because they save us pain and allow us to enjoy pleasure instead. We must therefore accept it without complaint when they sometimes collide with a bit of reality against which they are dashed to pieces.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.quote: I think computer viruses should count as life. I think it says something about human nature that the only form of life we have created so far is purely destructive. We've created life in our own image.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: It is not clear that intelligence has any long-term survival value.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: It matters if you just don't give up.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: There could be whole antiworlds and antipeople made out of antiparticles. However, if you ever meet your antiself, don't shake hands! You would both vanish in a great flash of light.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: The usual approach of science of constructing a mathematical model cannot answer the questions of why there should be a universe for the model to describe. Why does the universe go to all the bother of existing?
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: To confine our attention to terrestrial matters would be to limit the human spirit.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: Equations are more important to me because politics is for the present but an equation is something for eternity.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: According to my assessment, even if you have many more troops than others, how can that help you to victory?
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Act after having made assessments. The one who first knows the measure of far and near wins - this is the rule of armed struggle.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: All men can see these tactics whereby I conquer, but what none can see is the strategy out of which victory is evolved.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: All warfare is based on deception. Hence, when able to attack, we must seem unable; when using our forces, we must seem inactive; when we are near, we must make the enemy believe we are far away; when far away, we must make him believe we are near.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Amid the turmoil and tumult of battle, there may be seeming disorder and yet no real disorder at all.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: An army may be likened to water, for just as flowing water avoids the heights and hastens to the lowlands, so an army avoids strength and strikes weakness.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Apparent confusion is a product of good order; apparent cowardice, of courage; apparent weakness, of strength.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: As water has no constant form, there are in war no constant conditions.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: At first, then, exhibit the coyness of a maiden, until the enemy gives you an opening; afterwards emulate the rapidity of a running hare, and it will be too late for the enemy to oppose you.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Be extremely subtle, even to the point of formlessness. Be extremely mysterious, even to the point of soundlessness. Thereby you can be the director of the opponent's fate.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Bestow rewards without respect to customary practice; publish orders without respect to precedent. Thus you may employ the entire army as you would one man.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Bring war material with you from home, but forage on the enemy... use the conquered foe to augment one's own strength.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Carefully compare the opposing army with your own, so that you may know where strength is superabundant and where it is deficient.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Carefully study the well-being of your men, and do not overtax them. Concentrate your energy and hoard your strength. Keep your army continually on the move, and devise unfathomable plans.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Confront them with annihilation, and they will then survive; plunge them into a deadly situation, and they will then live. When people fall into danger, they are then able to strive for victory.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Do not swallow bait offered by the enemy. Do not interfere with an army that is returning home.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Energy may be likened to the bending of a crossbow; decision, to the releasing of a trigger.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Fighting with a large army under your command is nowise different from fighting with a small one: it is merely a question of instituting signs and signals.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: For the wise man delights in establishing his merit, the brave man likes to show his courage in action, the covetous man is quick at seizing advantages, and the stupid man has no fear of death.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Getting people to fight by letting the force of momentum work is like rolling logs and rocks. Logs and rocks are still when in a secure place, but roll on an incline; they remain stationary if square, they roll if round. Therefore, when people are skillfuly led into battle, the momentum is like that of round rocks rolling down a high mountain -- this is force.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Ground which can be abandoned but is hard to re-occupy is called entangling.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: He who exercises no forethought but makes light of his opponents is sure to be captured by them.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: He who is not sage and wise, humane and just, cannot use secret agent's. And he who is not delicate and subtle cannot get the truth out of them.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: He will win whose army is animated by the same spirit throughout all its ranks.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Hence the saying: If you know the enemy and you know yourself, your victory will not stand in doubt; if you now Heaven and you know Earth, you may make your victory complete.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Hold out baits to entice the enemy. Feign disorder, and crush him.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Hostile armies may face each other for years, striving for the victory which is decided in a single day. This being so, to remain in ignorance of the enemy's condition simply because one grudges the outlay of a hundred ounces of silver in honors and emoluments, is the height of inhumanity.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Humble words and increased preparations are signs that the enemy is about to advance. Violent language and driving forward as if to the attack are signs that he will retreat.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If fighting is sure to result in victory, then you must fight, even though the ruler forbid it; if fighting will not result in victory, then you must not fight even at the ruler's bidding.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If I am able to determine the enemy's dispositions while at the same time I conceal my own, then I can concentrate and he must divide.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If it is to your advantage, make a forward move; if not, stay where you are.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If not in the interests of the state, do not act. If you cannot succeed, do not use troops. If you are not in danger, do not fight.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If our soldiers are not overburdened with money, it is not because they have a distaste for riches; if their lives are not unduly long, it is not because they are disinclined to longevity.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If soldiers are punished before they have grown attached to you, they will not prove submissive; and, unless submissive, then will be practically useless. If, when the soldiers have become attached to you, punishments are not enforced, they will still be unless.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If those who are sent to draw water begin by drinking themselves, the army is suffering from thirst.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If we wish to fight, the enemy can be forced to an engagement even though he be sheltered behind a high rampart and a deep ditch. All we need do is attack some other place that he will be obliged to relieve.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If words of command are not clear and distinct, if orders are not thoroughly understood, the general is to blame. But if his orders are clear, and the soldiers nevertheless disobey, then it is the fault of their officers.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If you are situated at a great distance from the enemy, and the strength of the two armies is equal, it is not easy to provoke a battle, and fighting will be to your disadvantage.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If you fight with all your might, there is a chance of life; where as death is certain if you cling to your corner.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If you know yourself but not the enemy, for every victory gained you will also suffer a defeat.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If your opponent is of choleric temper, seek to irritate him. Pretend to be weak, that he may grow arrogant.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If, however, you are indulgent, but unable to make your authority felt; kind-hearted, but unable to enforce your commands; and incapable, moreover, of quelling disorder: then your soldiers must be likened to spoilt children; they are useless for any practical purpose.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: In all fighting, the direct method may be used for joining battle, but indirect methods will be needed in order to secure victory. In battle, there are not more than two methods of attack: the direct and the indirect; yet these two in combination give rise to an endless series of maneuvers.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: In making tactical dispositions, the highest pitch you can attain is to conceal them.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: In peace prepare for war, in war prepare for peace. The art of war is of vital importance to the state. It is matter of life and death, a road either to safety or to ruin. Hence under no circumstances can it be neglected.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: In the midst of difficulties we are always ready to seize an advantage, we may extricate ourselves from misfortune.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: In the practical art of war, the best thing of all is to take the enemy's country whole and intact; to shatter and destroy it is not so good.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: In warfare, first lay plans which will ensure victory, and then lead your army to battle; if you will not begin with stratagem but rely on brute strength alone, victory will no longer be assured.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: In warfare, there are no constant conditions. He who can modify his tactics in relation to his opponent will succeed and win.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: It is a doctrine of war not to assume the enemy will not come, but rather to rely on one's readiness to meet him; not to presume that he will not attack, but rather to make one's self invincible.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: It is only one who is thoroughly acquainted with the evils of war that can thoroughly understand the profitable way of carrying it on.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: It is only the enlightened ruler and the wise general who will use the highest intelligence of the army for the purposes of spying, and thereby they achieve great results.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: It is the business of a general to be quiet and thus ensure secrecy; upright and just, and thus maintain order.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: It is the rule in war, if our forces are ten to the enemy's one, to surround him; if five to one, to attack him; if twice as numerous, to divide our army into two.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: It is through the dispositions of an army that its condition may be discovered. Conceal your dispositions, and your condition will remain secret, which leads to victory,; show your dispositions, and your condition will become patent, which leads to defeat.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Know the enemy, know yourself; your victory will never be endangered. Know the ground, know the weather; your victory will then be total.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Knowledge of the enemy's dispositions can only be obtained from other men.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Like the sun and moon, they end but to begin anew; like the four seasons, they pass away to return once more.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Making no mistakes is what establishes the certainty of victory, for it means conquering an enemy that is already defeated.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Maneuvering with an army is advantageous; with an undisciplined multitude, most dangerous.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Move not unless you see an advantage; use not your troops unless there is something to be gained; fight not unless the position is critical.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Now a soldier's spirit is keenest in the morning; by noonday it has begun to flag; and in the evening, his mind is only on returning to camp.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Now this foreknowledge cannot be elicited from spirits; it cannot be obtained inductively from experience, nor by any deductive calculation.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: One defends when his strength is inadequate, he attacks when it is abundant.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: One mark of a great soldier is that he fight on his own terms or fights not at all.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: One who speaks deferentially but increases his preparations will advance. One who speaks belligerently and advances hastily will retreat.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: One whose troops repeatedly congregate in small groups here and there, whispering together, has lost the masses. One who frequently grants rewards is in deep distress. One who frequently imposes punishments is in great difficulty. One who is at first excessively brutal and then fears the masses is the pinnacle of stupidity.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Plan for what is difficult while it is easy, do what is great while it is small. The difficult things in this world must be done while they are easy, the greatest things in the world must be done while they are still small. For this reason sages never do what is great, and this is why they achieve greatness.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Prohibit the taking of omens, and do away with superstitious doubts. Then, until death itself comes, no calamity need be feared.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Rapidity is the essence of war: take advantage of the enemy's unreadiness, make your way by unexpected routes, and attack unguarded spots.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Regard your soldiers as your children, and they will follow you into the deepest valleys; look upon them as your own beloved sons, and they will stand by you even unto death.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Rewards for good service should not be deferred a single day.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Set the troops to their tasks without imparting your designs.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Should the enemy strengthen his van, he will weaken his rear; should he strengthen his rear, he will weaken his van; should he strengthen his left, he will weaken his right; should he strengthen his right, he will weaken his left. If he sends reinforcements everywhere, he will everywhere be weak.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: So in war, the way is to avoid what is strong and to strike at what is weak. Water shapes its course according to the nature of the ground over which it flows; the soldier works out his victory in relation to the foe whom he is facing.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: So there are five ways of knowing who will win. Those who know when to fight and when not to fight are victorious. Those who discern when to use many or few troops are victorious. Those whose upper and lower ranks have the same desire are victorious.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Someone unfamiliar with the mountains and forests cannot advance [the team]. One who does not employ local guides cannot gain the advantage.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Spies cannot be usefully employed without a certain intuitive sagacity.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Subjugating the enemy's army without fighting is the true pinnacle of excellence.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Success in warfare is gained by carefully accommodating ourselves to the enemy's purpose.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The art of giving orders is not to try to rectify the minor blunders and not be swayed by petty doubts.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The art of war teaches us to rely not on the likelihood of the enemy's not coming, but on our own readiness to receive him; not on the chance of his not attacking, but rather on the fact that we have made our position unassailable.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The best victory is when the opponent surrenders of its own accord before there are any actual hostilities.... It is best to win without fighting.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The consummate leader cultivates the moral law, and strictly adheres to method and discipline; thus it is in his power to control success.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The control of a large force is the same principle as the control of a few men: it is merely a question of dividing up their numbers.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The difficulty of tactical maneuvering consists in turning the devious into the direct, and misfortune into gain.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The end and aim of spying in all its five varieties is knowledge of the enemy; and this knowledge can only be derived, in the first instance, from the converted spy. Hence it is essential that the converted spy be treated with the utmost liberality.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The enemy's spies who have come to spy on us must be sought out, tempted with bribes, led away and comfortably housed. Thus they will become double agents and available for our service. It is through the information brought by the double agent that we are able to acquire and employ local and inward spies. It is owing to his information, again, that we can cause the doomed spy to carry false tidings to the enemy.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The general that hearkens to my counsel and acts upon it, will conquer: let such a one be retained in command! The general that hearkens not to my counsel nor acts upon it, will suffer defeat: - let such a one be dismissed!
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The general who wins a battle makes many calculations in his temple ere the battle is fought. The general who loses a battle makes but few calculations beforehand. Thus do many calculations lead to victory, and few calculations to defeat: how much more no calculation at all! It is by attention to this point that I can foresee who is likely to win or lose.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The leader of armies is the arbiter of the people's fate, the man on whom it depends whether the nation shall be in peace or in peril.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The natural formation of the country is the soldier's best ally; but a power of estimating the adversary, of controlling the forces of victory, and of shrewdly calculating difficulties, dangers and distances, constitutes the test of a great general.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The peak efficiency of knowledge and strategy is to make conflict unnecessary.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The quality of a decision is like the well-timed swoop of a falcon which enables it to strike and destroy its victim.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The skillful employer of men will employ the wise man, the brave man, the covetous man, and the stupid man.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The skillful tactician may be likened to the shuai-jan. Now the shuai-jan is a snake that is found in the Ch'ang mountains. Strike at its head, and you will be attacked by its tail; strike at its tail, and you will be attacked by its head; strike at its middle, and you will be attacked by head and tail both.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The spot where we intend to fight must not be made known; for then the enemy will have to prepare against a possible attack at several different points; and his forces being thus distributed in many directions, the numbers we shall have to face at any given point will be proportionately few.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: There are five dangerous faults which may affect a general: recklessness, which leads to destruction; cowardice, which leads to capture; a hasty temper, which can be provoked by insults; a delicacy of honour, which is sensitive to shame; over-solicitude for his men, which exposes him to worry and trouble.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: This does not mean that the enemy is to be allowed to escape. The object is to make him believe that there is a road to safety, and thus prevent his fighting with the courage of despair. After that, you may crush him.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Those who do not know the plans of competitors cannot prepare alliances. Those who do not know the lay of the land cannot maneuver their forces. Those who do not use local guides cannot take advantage of the ground.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Throw your soldiers into positions whence there is no escape, and they will prefer death to flight. If they will face death, there is nothing they may not achieve.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Thus it is that in war the victorious strategist only seeks battle after the victory has been won, whereas he who is destined to defeat first fights and afterwards looks for victory.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Thus the skillful general conducts his army just as though he were leading a single man, willy-nilly, by the hand.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Thus those skilled in war subdue the enemy's army without battle.... They conquer by strategy.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: To capture the enemy's entire army is better than to destroy it; to take intact a regiment, a company, or a squad is better than to destroy them. For to win one hundred victories in one hundred battles is not the supreme of excellence. To subdue the enemy without fighting is the supreme excellence.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: To maintain an army at a distance causes the people to be impoverished.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: To perceive victory when it is known to all is not really skillful... It does not take much strength to lift a hair, it does not take sharp eyes to see the sun and moon, it does not take sharp ears to hear the thunderclap.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: To plan secretly, to move surreptitiously, to foil the enemy's intentions and balk his schemes, so that at last the day may be won without shedding a drop of blood.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Too frequent rewards indicate that the general is at the end of his resources; too frequent punishments that he is in acute distress.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Unhappy is the fate of one who tries to win his battles and succeed in his attacks without cultivating the spirit of enterprise, for the result is waste of time and general stagnation.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Unless you enter the tiger's lair, you cannot get hold of the tiger's cub's.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: We cannot enter into alliance with neighboring princes until we are acquainted with their designs. We are not fit to lead an army on the march unless we are familiar with the face of the country - its mountains and forests, its pitfalls and precipices, its marshes and swamps. We shall be unable to turn natural advantages to account unless we make use of local guides.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: What enables the wise sovereign and the good general to strike and conquer, and achieve things beyond the reach of ordinary men, is foreknowledge.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: What is of supreme importance in war is to attack the enemy's strategy.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: What the ancients called a clever fighter is one who not only wins, but excels in winning with ease.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: When a general, unable to estimate the enemy's strength, allows an inferior force to engage a larger one, or hurls a weak detachment against a powerful one, and neglects to place picked soldiers in the front rank, the result must be rout.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: When envoys are sent with compliments in their mouths, it is a sign that the enemy wishes for a truce.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: When he utilizes combined energy, his fighting men become as it were like unto rolling logs or stones. For it is the nature of a log or stone to remain motionless on level ground, and to move when on a slope; if four-cornered, to come to a standstill, but if round-shaped to go rolling down.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: When torrential water tosses boulders, it is because of its momentum. When the strike of a hawk breaks the body of its prey, it is because of timing.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: When you do battle, even if you are winning, if you continue for a long time it will dull your forces and blunt you edge...If you keep your armies out in the field for a long time, your supplies will be insufficient. Transportation of provisions itself consumes 20 times the amount transported.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: When you surround an army, leave an outlet free. Do not press a desperate foe too hard.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Who does not know the evils of war cannot appreciate its benefits.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Whoever is first in the field and awaits the coming of the enemy, will be fresh for the fight; whoever is second in the field and has to hasten to battle will arrive exhausted.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: With regard to precipitous heights, if you are beforehand with your adversary, you should occupy the raised and sunny spots, and there wait for him to come up.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: To defeat a strong enemy: deploy forces to defend the strategic points; exercise vigilance in preparation; do not be indolent. Deeply investigate the true situation. Secretly await their laxity. Wait until they leave their stronghold. Then seize what they love.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Engage only when it is in the interests of the state: cease when it is to its detriment. Do not move unless there are definite advantages to be won.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: For to win one hundred victories in one hundred battles is not the acme of skill. To subdue the enemy without fighting is the acme of skill.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: He who is prudent and lies in wait for an enemy who is not, will be victorious.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: He who knows when he can fight and when he cannot, will be victorious.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Hence that general is skillful in attack whose opponent does not know what to defend; and he is skilful in defense whose opponent does not know what to attack.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If ignorant both of your enemy and yourself, you are certain to be in peril.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If you are far from the enemy, make him believe you are near.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: If you know the enemy and know yourself you need not fear the results of a hundred battles.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Invincibility lies in the defence; the possibility of victory in the attack.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: It is essential to seek out enemy agents who have come to conduct espionage against you and to bribe them to serve you. Give them instructions and care for them. Thus doubled agents are recruited and used.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Know thy self, know thy enemy. A thousand battles, a thousand victories.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: Now the reason the enlightened prince and the wise general conquer the enemy whenever they move and their achievements surpass those of ordinary men is foreknowledge.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.quote: The only way to deal with an unfree world is to become so absolutely free that your very existence is an act of rebellion.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: The purpose of a writer is to keep civilization from destroying itself.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Always go too far, because that's where you'll find the truth.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: I would rather live my life as if there is a God and die to find out there isn't, than live my life as if there isn't and die to find out there is.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Freedom is nothing but a chance to be better.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Always there comes an hour when one is weary of one's work and devotion to duty, and all one craves for is a loved face, the warmth and wonder of a loving heart.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Men who have greatness within them don't go in for politics.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: The struggle to the top alone will make a human heart swell.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: I rebel, therefore I exist.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Men must live and create. Live to the point of tears.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Nobody realizes that some people expend tremendous energy merely to be normal.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Peace is the only battle worth waging.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: There is no fate that cannot be surmounted by scorn.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: What we learn in a time of pestilence: that there are more things to admire in men than to despise.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Every revolutionary ends as an oppressor or a heretic.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: We always deceive ourselves twice about the people we love — first to their advantage, then to their disadvantage.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: You know what charm is: a way of getting the answer yes without having asked any clear question.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: An intellectual is someone whose mind watches itself.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: The future is the only kind of property that the masters willingly concede to slaves.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: We have art in order not to die of life.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: A person's life purpose is nothing more than to rediscover, through the detours of art, or love, or passionate work, those one or two images in the presence of which his heart first opened.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Although I'm only fourteen, I know quite well what I want, I know who is right and who is wrong. I have my opinions, my own ideas and principles, and although it may sound pretty mad from an adolescent, I feel more of a person than a child, I feel quite independent of anyone.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: An empty day, though clear and bright, Is just as dark as any night.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: And finally I twist my heart round again, so that the bad is on the outside and the good is on the inside, and keep on trying to find a way of becoming what I would so like to be, and could be, if there weren't any other people living in the world.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Another fact that doesn't exactly brighten up our days is that Mr. Van Maaren, the man who works in the warehouse, is getting suspicious about the Annex.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: But feelings can't be ignored, no matter how unjust or ungrateful they seem.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: But I won't bore you any longer on the subject of old men. It won't make things any better and all my plans of revenge (such as disconnecting the lamp, shutting the door, hiding his clothes) must be abandoned in order to keep the peace. Oh, I'm becoming so sensible!...
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: But i've slammed the door to my inner self; if he ever wants to force the lock again, he'll have to use a harder crowbar!
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: By thinking, nobody can ever get worse but will only get better.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Daddy said: "All children must look after their own upbringing." Parents can only give good advice or put them on the right paths, but the final forming of a person's character lies in their own hands.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Deep down I know I could never be that innocent again, however much I'd like to be.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Don't condemn me, remember rather that sometimes I, too, can reach the bursting point.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Earning happiness means doing good and working, not speculating and being lazy. Laziness may look inviting, but only work gives you true satisfaction.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Everyone thinks I'm showing off when I talk, ridiculous when I'm silent, insolent when I answer, cunning when I have a good idea, lazy when I'm tired, selfish when I eat one bite more than I should.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: He clings to his solitude, to his affected indifference and his grown-up ways, but it's just an act, so as never, never to show his real feelings.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: How noble and good everyone could be if, every evening before falling asleep, they were to recall to their minds the events of the whole day and consider exactly what has been good and bad. Then without realizing it, you try to improve yourself at the start of each new day.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Human greatness does not lie in wealth or power, but in character and goodness. People are just people, and all people have faults and shortcomings, but all of us are born with a basic goodness.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I believe that in the course of the next century the notion that it's a woman's duty to have children will change and make way for the respect and admiration of all women, who bear their burdens without complaint or a lot of pompous words!
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I can recapture everything when I write, my thoughts, my ideals and my fantasies.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I can't let them see my doubts, or the wounds they've inflicted on me.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I don't believe the war is simply the work of politicians and capitalists. Oh no, the common man is every bit as guilty; otherwise, people and nations would have rebelled long ago!.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I don't dare do anything anymore, 'cause I'm afraid it's not allowed.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I don't have much in the way of money or worldly possessions, I'm not beautiful, intelligent or clever, but I'm happy, and I intend to stay that way! I was born happy, I love people, I have a trusting nature, and I'd like everyone else to be happy too.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I feel the suffering of millions. And yet, when I look up at the sky, I somehow feel that every-thing will change for the better, that this cruelty too shall end, that peace and tranquility will return once more.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I had an occasional flash of understanding, but then got selfishly wrapped up again in my own problems and pleasures.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I hid myself within myself... and quietly wrote down all my joys, sorrows and contempt in my diary.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I know what I want, I have a goal, an opinion, I have a religion and love. Let me be myself and then I am satisfied. I know that I'm a woman, a woman with inward strength and plenty of courage.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I long to ride a bike, dance, whistle, look at the world, feel young and know that I'm free, and yet I can't let it show. Just imagine what would happen if all eight of us were to feel sorry for ourselves or walk around with the discontent clearly visible on our faces. Where would that get us?
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I must uphold my ideals, for perhaps the time will come when I shall be able to carry them out.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I must work, so as not to be a fool, to get on, to become a journalist, because that's what I want!... I can't imagine that I would have to lead the same sort of life as Mummy and all the women who do their work and are then forgotten. I must have something besides a husband and children, something that I can devote myself to!
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I simply can't imagine the world will ever be normal again for us. I do talk about "after the war," but it's as if I'm talking about a castle in the air, something that can never come true.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I soothe my conscience now with the thought that it is better for hard words to be on paper than that Mummy should carry them in her heart.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I think it's odd that grown-ups quarrel so easily and so often and about such petty matters. Up to now I always thought bickering was just something children did and that they outgrew it.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I want friends, not admirers. People who respect me for my character and my deeds, not my flattering smile. The circle around me would be much smaller, but what does that matter, as long as they're sincere?
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I want something from Daddy that he is not able to give me... It is only that I long for Daddy's real love: not only as his child, but for me — Anne, myself.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I want to write, but more than that, I want to bring out all kinds of things that lie buried deep in my heart.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I wonder if anyone can ever succeed in making their children content.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I'm currently in the middle of a depression. I couldn't really tell you what set it off, but I think it stems from my cowardice, which confronts me at every turn.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I've reached the point where I hardly care whether I live or die. The world will keep on turning without me, I can't do anything to change events anyway.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: If the truth is told, things are just as bad as you yourself care to make them.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: In the future I'm going to devote less time to sentimentality and more time to reality.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Just imagine how interesting it would be if I were to publish a romance of the "Secret Annexe." The title alone would be enough to make people think it was a detective story.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Leave me in peace, let me sleep one night at least without my pillow being wet with tears, my eyes burning and my head throbbing.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Let's not talk about it any more, but if you still want anything please write to me about it, because I can say what I mean much better on paper.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Looking back, I realize that this period of my life has irrevocably come to a close; my happy-go-lucky, carefree schooldays are gone forever. I don't even miss them. I've outgrown them. I can no longer just kid around, since my serious side is always there.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Not being able to go outside upsets me more than I can say, and I'm terrified our hiding place will be discovered and that we'll be shot.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Older people have formed their opinions about everything, and don't waver before they act. It's twice as hard for us young ones to hold our ground, and maintain our opinions, in a time when all ideals are being shattered and destroyed, when people are showing their worst side, and do not know whether to believe in truth and right and God.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: One must apply one's reason to everything here, learning to obey, to shut up, to help, to be good, to give in, and I don't know what else. I'm afraid I shall use up all my brains too quickly, and I haven't got so very many. Then I shall not have any left for when the war is over.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Ordinary people don't know how much books can mean to someone who's cooped up.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Ordinary people simply don't know what books mean to us, shut up here. Reading, learning, and the radio are our amusements.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Parents can only advise their children or point them in the right direction. Ultimately people shape their own characters.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: People can so easily be tempted by slackness... and by money.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: People can tell you to keep your mouth shut, but that doesn't stop you from having your own opinion.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: People who have a religion should be glad, for not everyone has the gift of believing in heavenly things.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Riches, power and fame last only for a few years! Why do people cling so desperately to these transitory things? Why can't people who have more than they need for themselves give that surplus to their fellow citizens? Why should some people have such a hard time during their few years on this earth?
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Riches, prestige, everything can be lost. But the happiness in your heart can only be dimmed; it will always be there as long as you live, to make you happy again. Whenever you're feeling lonely or sad, try going to the loft on a beautiful day and looking outside. Not at the houses and the rooftops, but at the sky. As long as you can look fearlessly at the sky, you'll know that your pure within and will find happiness once more.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Sleep makes the silence and the terrible fear go by more quickly, helps pass the time, since it's impossible to kill.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Sometimes I'm so deeply buried under self-reproaches that I long for a word of comfort to help me dig myself out again.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: The Annex is an ideal place to hide in. It may be damp and lopsided, but there's probably not a more comfortable hiding place in all of Amsterdam. No, in all of Holland.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: The best remedy for those who are afraid, lonely or unhappy is to go outside, somewhere where they can be quiet, alone with the heavens, nature and God. Because only then does one feel that all is as it should be.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: The weak fall, but the strong will remain and never go under!
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: The world has plenty of room, riches, money and beauty... Let us begin by dividing it more fairly.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Then I fall asleep with a stupid feeling of wishing to be different from what I am or from what I want to be; perhaps to behave differently from the way I want to behave or do behave.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Then, without realizing it, you try to improve yourself at the start of each new day; of course, you achieve quite a lot in the course of time. Anyone can do this, it costs nothing and is certainly very helpful. Whoever doesn't know it must learn and find by experience that a quiet conscience makes one strong.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: There's one golden rule to keep before you: laugh about everything and don't bother yourself about the others!
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: There's only one rule you need to remember: laugh at everything and forget everybody else! It sound egotistical, but it's actually the only cure for those suffering from self-pity.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: They mustn't know my despair, I can't let them see the wounds which they have caused, I couldn't bear their sympathy and their kind-hearted jokes, it would only make me want to scream all the more. If I talk, everyone thinks I'm showing off; when I'm silent they think I'm ridiculous; rude if I answer, sly if I get a good idea, lazy if I'm tired, selfish if I eat a mouthful more than I should, stupid, cowardly, crafty, etc. etc.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Thinking about the suffering of those you hold dear can reduce you to tears; in fact, you could spend the whole day crying.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: This week I've been reading a lot and doing little work. That's the way things ought to be. That's surely the road to success.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: We lit the stove a few days ago and the entire room is filled with smoke. I prefer central heating, and I'm probably not the only one.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: We're all alive, but we don't know why or what for; we're all searching for happiness; we're all leading lives which are different and yet the same.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: We've all been a little confused this past week, because our dearly beloved Westertoren bells have been carted off to be melted down for the war, so we have no idea of the exact time, either night or day.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: What I condemn are our system of values and the men who don't acknowledge how great, difficult, but ultimately beautiful women's share in society is.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: What is done cannot be undone, but one can prevent it happening again.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: When I write I can shake off all my cares. My sorrow disappears, my spirits are revived.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Where there's hope, there's life. It fills us with fresh courage and makes us strong again.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Who knows, perhaps he doesn't care about me at all and look at the others in just the same way.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Who would ever think that so much went on in the soul of a young girl?
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Why are millions spent on the war each day, while not a penny is available for... artists or the poor? Why do people have to starve when mountains of food are rotting away in other parts of the world? Oh, why are people so crazy?
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Writing in a diary is a really strange experience for someone like me. Not only because I've never written anything before, but also because it seems to me that later on neither I nor anyone else will be interested in the musings of a thirteen-year old school girl. Oh well, it doesn't matter. I feel like writing.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: Yes, there is no doubt that paper is patient and as I don't intend to show this cardboard-covered notebook, bearing the proud name of "diary," to anyone, unless I find a real friend, boy or girl, probably nobody cares. And now I come to the root of the matter, the reason for my starting a diary: it is that I have no such real friend.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: You can get around to meaningful conversations more quickly in the dark than with the sun tickling your face.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: You only really get to know people when you've had a jolly good row with them.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I think spring is inside me. I feel spring awakening, I feel it in my entire body and soul. I have to force myself to act normally. I'm in a state of utter confusion, don't know what to read, what to write, what to do. I only know that I'm longing for something.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: In spite of everything, I still believe that people are really good at heart.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: I must indeed, try to control the talking habit, but I'm afraid that little can be done, as my case is hereditary. My mother, too, is fond of chatting, and has handed this weakness down to me.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: You can always, always give something, even if it's only kindness.
quotes.author: Anne Frank

quotes.quote: A creative man is motivated by the desire to achieve, not by the desire to beat others.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: The world you desired can be won, it exists, it is real, it is possible, it's yours.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: A desire presupposes the possibility of action to achieve it; action presupposes a goal which is worth achieving.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Achievement of your happiness is the only moral purpose of your life, and that happiness, not pain or mindless self-indulgence, is the proof of your moral integrity, since it is the proof and the result of your loyalty to the achievement of your values.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Ask yourself whether the dream of heaven and greatness should be waiting for us in our graves - or whether it should be ours here and now and on this earth.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Civilization is the progress toward a society of privacy. The savage's whole existence is public, ruled by the laws of his tribe. Civilization is the process of setting man free from men.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Contradictions do not exist. Whenever you think you are facing a contradiction, check your premises. You will find that one of them is wrong.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Do not ever say that the desire to "do good" by force is a good motive. Neither power-lust nor stupidity are good motives.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Every man builds his world in his own image. He has the power to choose, but no power to escape the necessity of choice.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Evil requires the sanction of the victim.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Force and mind are opposites; morality ends where a gun begins.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: From the smallest necessity to the highest religious abstraction, from the wheel to the skyscraper, everything we are and everything we have comes from one attribute of man - the function of his reasoning mind.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: God... a being whose only definition is that he is beyond man's power to conceive.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Government "help" to business is just as disastrous as government persecution... the only way a government can be of service to national prosperity is by keeping its hands off.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: I don't build in order to have clients. I have clients in order to build.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: I swear, by my life and my love of it, that I will never live for the sake of another man, nor ask another man to live for mine.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: If any civilization is to survive, it is the morality of altruism that men have to reject.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Individual rights are not subject to a public vote; a majority has no right to vote away the rights of a minority; the political function of rights is precisely to protect minorities from oppression by majorities (and the smallest minority on earth is the individual).
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Individual rights are the means of subordinating society to moral law.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: It only stands to reason that where there's sacrifice, there's someone collecting the sacrificial offerings. Where there's service, there is someone being served. The man who speaks to you of sacrifice is speaking of slaves and masters, and intends to be the master.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Just as man can't exist without his body, so no rights can exist without the right to translate one's rights into reality, to think, to work and keep the results, which means: the right of property.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Man's unique reward, however, is that while animals survive by adjusting themselves to their background, man survives by adjusting his background to himself.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Only the man who does not need it, is fit to inherit wealth, the man who would make his fortune no matter where he started.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: People create their own questions because they are afraid to look straight. All you have to do is look straight and see the road, and when you see it, don't sit looking at it - walk.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Reason is not automatic. Those who deny it cannot be conquered by it. Do not count on them. Leave them alone.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Run for your life from any man who tells you that money is evil. That sentence is the leper's bell of an approaching looter.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: So you think that money is the root of all evil. Have you ever asked what is the root of all money?
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: The hardest thing to explain is the glaringly evident which everybody had decided not to see.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: The ladder of success is best climbed by stepping on the rungs of opportunity.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: The man who lets a leader prescribe his course is a wreck being towed to the scrap heap.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: The purpose of morality is to teach you, not to suffer and die, but to enjoy yourself and live.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: The smallest minority on earth is the individual. Those who deny individual rights cannot claim to be defenders of minorities.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: The truth is not for all men, but only for those who seek it.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: The worst guilt is to accept an unearned guilt.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: There can be no such thing, in law or in morality, as actions to an individual, but permitted to a mob.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: There is a level of cowardice lower than that of the conformist: the fashionable non-conformist.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Throughout the centuries there were men who took first steps, down new roads, armed with nothing but their own vision.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: To achieve, you need thought. You have to know what you are doing and that's real power.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Upper classes are a nation's past; the middle class is its future.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: We are fast approaching the stage of the ultimate inversion: the stage where the government is free to do anything it pleases, while the citizens may act only by permission; which is the stage of the darkest periods of human history, the stage of rule by brute force.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Wealth is the product of man's capacity to think.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: When I die, I hope to go to Heaven, whatever the Hell that is.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: When man learns to understand and control his own behavior as well as he is learning to understand and control the behavior of crop plants and domestic animals, he may be justified in believing that he has become civilized.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: It's strange how simple things become, once you see them clearly.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: A brand new mediocrity is thought more of than accustomed excellence.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: A man of honour should never forget what he is because he sees what others are.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: A wise man gets more use from his enemies than a fool from his friends.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Always have your mouth full of sugar to sweeten your words, so that even your ill-wishers enjoy them.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Always leave something to wish for; otherwise you will be miserable from your very happiness.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: At twenty a man is a peacock, at thirty a lion, at forty a camel, at fifty a serpent, at sixty a dog, at seventy an ape, and at eighty nothing.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Attempt easy tasks as if they were difficult, and difficult as if they were easy; in the one case that confidence may not fall asleep, in the other that it may not be dismayed.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Avoid affectation. The more merit, the less affectation, which gives a vulgar flavor. The most eminent merits lose most by it, for they appear proud and artificial instead of being the product of nature, and the natural is always more pleasing than the artificial. One always feels sure that the man who affects a virtue has it not.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Because the ignorant do not know themselves, they never know for what they are lacking. Some would be sages if they did not believe they were so already.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Better to be cheated by the price than by the merchandise.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Complaints will always discredit you. Rather than compassion and consolation, they provoke passion and insolence, and encourage those who hear our complaints to behave like those we complain about. Once divulged to others, the offenses done to us seem to make others pardonable. Some complain of past offenses and give rise to future ones.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Cultivate tact, for it is the mark of culture, and as important as character itself. It is the lubricant of human relationships, softening contacts and minimizing friction.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Display startling novelty-rise afresh like the sun every day. Change too the scene on which you shine, so that your loss may be felt in the old scenes of your triumph, while the novelty of your powers wins applause in the new.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Don't express your ideas too clearly. Most people think little of what they understand, and venerate what they do not.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Don't live by generalities, unless it be to act virtuously, and don't ask desire to follow precise laws, for you will have to drink tomorrow from the water you scorn today.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Everything foreign is respected, partly because it comes from afar, partly because it is ready made and perfect.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Exaggeration is a prodigality of the judgment which shows the narrowness of one's knowledge or one's taste.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Excellence resides in quality, not in quantity. The best is always few and rare; much lowers value.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: For a thing to remain undone nothing more is needed than to think of it done.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Fortune pays you sometimes for the intensity of her favors by the shortness of their duration. She soon tires of carrying any one long on her shoulders.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Great ability develops and reveals itself increasingly with every new assignment.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Honorable beginnings should serve to awaken curiosity, not to heighten people's expectations. We are much better off when reality surpasses our expectations, and something turns out better than we thought it would. This rule does not hold true for bad things: when an evil has been exaggerated, its reality makes people applaud. What was feared as ruinous comes to seem tolerable.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Hope is a great falsifier. Let good judgment keep her in check.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: If there is too much display today there will be nothing to show tomorrow. Always have some novelty with which to dazzle.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: If you are wise, live as you can; if you cannot, live as you would.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: If you cannot make knowledge your servant, make it your friend.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: In conversation, discretion is more importance than eloquence.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: It is a great misfortune to be of use to nobody; scarcely less to be of use to everybody.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: It is a great piece of skill to know how to guide your luck even while waiting for it.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: It is a novel kind of supremacy, the best that life can offer, to have as servants by skill those who by nature are our masters.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: It is better to sleep on things beforehand than to lie awake about them afterward.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: It is only by mature meditation on the possibilities and probabilities of future events — that we can elude the tortuous troubles of the tomorrows.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: It is profound philosophy to sound the depths of feeling and distinguish traits of character. Men must be studied as deeply as books.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Keep expectation alive. Keep stirring it up. Let much promise more, and great deeds herald greater.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Know how to choose well. Most of life depends thereon. It needs good taste and correct judgment, for which neither intellect nor study suffices.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Know how to play the card of contempt. It is the most politic kind of revenge. For there are many of whom we should have known nothing if their distinguished opponents had taken no notice of them. There is no revenge like oblivion, for it is the entombment of the unworthy in the dust of their own nothingness.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Know how to use evasion. That is how smart people get out of difficulties.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Knowing how to keep a friend is more important than gaining a new one.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Knowledge and courage. These are the elements of greatness. Because they are immortal they bestow immortality. Each is as much as he knows, and the wise can do anything. A person without knowledge is in world without light. Wisdom and strength are the eyes and hands. Knowledge without courage is sterile.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Life is a warfare against the malice of others.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Make your friends your teachers and mingle the pleasures of conversation with the advantages of instruction.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Man is born a barbarian, and only raises himself above the beast by culture.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Many get the repute of being witty but thereby lose the credit of being sensible. Jest has its little hour, seriousness should have all the rest.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Many have had their greatness made for them by their enemies.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Many owe their greatness to their enemies. Flattery is fiercer than hatred, for hatred corrects the faults flattery had disguised.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Many pleasant things are better when they belong to someone else. ... When things belong to others, we enjoy them twice as much, without the risk of losing them, and with the pleasure of novelty.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Mediocrity obtains more with application than superiority without it.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Most do violence to their natural aptitude, and thus attain superiority in nothing.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Nature scarcely ever gives us the very best; for that we must have recourse to art.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Never open the door to the least of evils, for many other, greater ones lurk outside.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Never risk your reputation on a single trial, because if it does not turn out well, the damage will be irreparable.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: None is so perfect that he does not need at times the advice of others.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Not believing others implies that you yourself are deceitful. The liar suffers twice: he neither believes nor is believed.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Nothing arouses ambition so much in the heart as the trumpet-clang of another's fame.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: One deceit needs many others, and so the whole house is built in the air and must soon come to the ground.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: One should cultivate good habits of memory, for it is capable of making existence a Paradise or an Inferno.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Politeness and a sense of honor have this advantage: we bestow them on others without losing a thing.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Share weight and woe, for misfortune falls with double force on him that stands alone.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Some die because they feel everything, others because they feel nothing. Some are fools because they suffer no regrets, and others because they do.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Some marry the first information they receive, and turn what comes later into their concubine. Since deceit is always first to arrive, there is no room left for truth.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Some people belong entirely to others ... They have not a day, not an hour to call their own, so completely do they give themselves to others. This is true even in matters of understanding. Some people know everything for others and nothing for themselves.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Sometimes it proves the highest understanding not to understand.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The best remedy for disturbances is to let them run their course, for so they quiet down.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The envious die not once, but as oft as the envied win applause.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The greatest fool is he who thinks he is not one and all others are.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The one rule for pleasing: whet the appetite, keep people hungry.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The person who does not know how to put up with others should retire into himself, if indeed he can suffer even himself.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The right kind of leisure is better than the wrong kind of work.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The sage has one advantage: he is immortal. If this is not his century, many others will be.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The sage never seems to know his own merits, for only by not noticing them can you call others' attention to them.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The sole advantage of power is that you can do more good.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The true way is the middle one, halfway between deserving a place and pushing oneself into it.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The wise are always impatient, for he that increases knowledge increases impatience of folly.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: The wise physician, if he has failed to cure, looks out for someone who, under the name of consultation, may help him carry out the corpse.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: There is none who cannot teach somebody something, and there is none so excellent but he is excelled.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: There must be something good in a thing that pleases so many; even if it cannot be explained, it is certainly enjoyed.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Those who insist on the dignity of their office show they have not deserved it, and that it is too much for them.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Those who want to look like hard workers give the impression that they aren't up to their jobs.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: To dissent from others' views is regarded as an insult because it is their condemnation.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: To hear a prince's secrets is not a privilege but a burden. Many smash the mirror that reminds them of their ugliness. They cannot stand to see those who saw them.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Trust the friends of today as though they will be the enemies of tomorrow.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Truth always lags last, limping along on the arm of Time.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Virtue alone is for real; all else is sham. Talent and greatness depend on virtue, not on fortune. Only virtue is sufficient unto herself. She makes us love the living and remember the dead.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Watchfulness is the only guard against cunning. Be intent on his intentions. Many succeed in making others do their own affairs, and unless you possess the key to their motives you may at any moment be forced to take their chestnuts out of the fire to the damage of your own fingers.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: We have more days to live through than pleasures. Be slow in enjoyment, quick at work, for men see work ended with pleasure, pleasure ended with regret.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: We often have to put up with most from those on whom we most depend.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: What is not seen is as if it was not. Even the Right does not receive proper consideration if it does not seem right.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: When you find Fortune favorable, stride boldly forward, for she favors the bold, and being a woman, the young.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Whereas wisdom favors the probabilities, folly favors only the possibilities.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Wisdom does not trust to probabilities; it always marches in the midday light of reason.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Wise men appreciate all men, for they see the good in each and know how hard it is to make anything good.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: You have to appear wiser and more prudent than is required by the people you are dealing with if you want to give a high opinion of yourself.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: You may be obliged to wage war, but not to use poisoned arrows.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: You should aim to be independent of any one vote, of any one fashion, of any one century.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: When you counsel someone, you should appear to be reminding him of something he had forgotten, not of the light he was unable to see.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Don't take the wrong side of an argument just because your opponent has taken the right side.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: When a man's knowledge is deep, he speaks well of an enemy. Instead of seeking revenge, he extends unexpected generosity. He turns insult into humour and astonishes his adversary who finds no reason not to trust him.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Never do anything when you are in a temper, for you will do everything wrong.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Know or listen to those who know.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Do what is easy as if it were difficult and what is difficult as if it were easy.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Fame always goes with the principles.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: To know how to refuse is as important as to know how to consent.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Nothing really belongs to us but time, which even he has who has nothing else.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Be content to act, and leave the talking to others.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Art is not essential where nature is sufficient.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: If to talk to oneself when alone is folly, it must be doubly unwise to listen to oneself in the presence of others.
quotes.author: Baltasar Gracián

quotes.quote: Without civic morality communities perish; without personal morality their survival has no value.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: If all our happiness is bound up entirely in our personal circumstances, it is difficult not to demand of life more than it has to give.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Drunkenness is temporary suicide; the happiness that it brings is merely negative, a momentary cessation of unhappiness.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: The degree of one's emotion varies inversely with one's knowledge of the facts – the less you know the hotter you get.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: It is only intellect that keeps me sane; perhaps this makes me over value intellect against feelings.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: The thing that I should wish to obtain from money would be leisure with security.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Too little liberty brings stagnation, and too much brings chaos.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: The good life is a happy life. I do not mean that if you are good you will be happy; I mean that if you are happy you will be good.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Speaking personally, I have found the happiness of parenthood greater than any other that I have experienced.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Patriots always talk of dying for their country and never of killing for their country.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Science is what you know, philosophy is what you don't know.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: There are two motives for reading a book: one that you enjoy it, the other, that you can boast about it.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Religion is a matter of speculation.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Whenever one finds oneself inclined to bitterness, it is a sign of emotional failure.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: The wise man thinks about his troubles only when there is some purpose in doing so, at other times he thinks about other things.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: Three passions, simple but overwhelmingly strong, have governed my life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: A hallucination is a fact, not an error; what is erroneous is a judgment based upon it.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: A happy life must be to a great extent a quiet life, for it is only in an atmosphere of quiet that true joy dare live.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: A life without adventure is likely to be unsatisfying, but a life in which adventure is allowed to take whatever form it will is sure to be short.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: A process which led from the amoeba to man appeared to the philosophers to be obviously a progress though whether the amoeba would agree with this opinion is not known.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: A sense of duty is useful in work but offensive in personal relations. People wish to be liked, not to be endured with patient resignation.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: A truer image of the world, I think, is obtained by picturing things as entering into the stream of time from an eternal world outside, than from a view which regards time as the devouring tyrant of all that is.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell
